a: "Beittam" — belele reviiyyot uvelele shabbatot.

Shekken matzinu bime shimon ben shatach sheyyardu lahem geshamim belele reviiyyot uvelele shabbatot, ad shennaasu chittim kichlayot, useorim kegarine zetim, vaadashim kedinre zahav, vetzarru mehem dugema laddorot, lehodia kamma hachet gorem, shenneemar: "avonotechem hittu elle vechattotechem manu hattov mikkem".

Vechen matzinu bime hordos, shehayu oskin bevinyan bet hammikdash, vehayu yordin geshamim ballayla, lemachar nashva haruach venitpazzeru heavim vezarcha hachamma, veyatzu haam limlachtan, veyadu shemmelechet shamayim bidehem.

Maase sheshshalchu lechoni hameaggel vechulei. tanu rabbanan: paam achat yatza rov adar velo yardu geshamim, shalchu lechoni hameaggel: hitpallel veyerdu geshamim! hitpallel, velo yardu geshamim. ag uga veamad betochah, kederech sheasa chavakkuk hannavi, shenneemar: "al mishmarti eemoda veetyatztzeva al matzor vegomer".

Amar lefanav: ribbono shel olam! banecha samu penehem alay, sheani keven bayit lefanecha. nishba ani beshimcha haggadol sheeni zaz mikkan ad shetterachem al banecha. hitchilu geshamim menattefin. amru lo talmidav: rabbi! reinuch velo namut, kimdummin anu sheen geshamim yordin ella lehattir shevuatcha.

Amar: lo kach shaalti, ella gishme borot shichin umearot. yardu bezaaf, ad shekkol tippa vetippa kimlo pi chavit. veshiaru chachamim sheen tippa pechuta millog. amru lo talmidav: rabbi, reinuch velo namut, kimdummin anu sheen geshamim yordin ella leabbed haolam.

Amar lefanav: lo kach shaalti, ella gishme ratzon beracha unedava. yardu ketiknan, ad shealu kol haam lehar habbayit, mippene haggeshamim. amru lo: rabbi, keshem shehitpallalta sheyyerdu, kach hitpallel veyelchu lahem. amar lahem: kach mekubbelani sheen mitpallelin al rov hattova.

Af al pi chen, haviu li par hodaa. heviu lo par hodaa, samach shete yadav alav, veamar lefanav: ribbono shel olam! ammecha yisrael shehotzeta mimmitzrayim enan yecholin lo berov tova velo berov pureanut. kaasta alehem — enan yecholin laamod, hishpata alehem tova — enan yecholin laamod, yehi ratzon millefanecha sheyyippasku haggeshamim, vihe revach baolam. miyyad nashva haruach, venitpazzeru heavim, vezarcha hachamma, veyatzu haam lassade veheviu lahem kemehin ufitriyyot.
Shalach lo shimon ben shatach: ilmale choni atta, gozrani alecha nidduy. sheillu shanim kishne eliyyahu shemmaftechot geshamim beyado shel eliyyahu, lo nimtza shem shamayim mitchallel al yadcha,

Aval ma eese lecha, sheatta mitchatte lifne hammakom veose lecha retzoncha, keven shemmitchatte al aviv veose lo retzono, veomer lo: abba, holichani lerochtzeni bechammin. shotfeni betzonen. ten li egozim, shekedim, afarsekim verimmonim — venoten lo. vealecha hakkatuv omer: "yismach avicha veimmecha vetagel yoladtecha".
Tanu rabbanan: ma shalchu bene lishkat haggazit lechoni hameaggel — "vetigzar omer veyakom lach veal derachecha naga or".
"Vetigzar omer" — atta gazarta millematta, vehakkadosh baruch hu mekayyem maamarcha milmala. "veal derachecha naga or" — dor shehaya afel hearta bitfillatecha.

"Ki hishpilu vattomer geva" — dor shehaya shafel higbahto bitfillatecha. "veshach enayim yoshia" — dor sheshshach baavono hoshato bitfillatecha. "yemallet i naki" — dor shello haya naki millatto bitfillatecha. "venimlat bevor kappecha" — millatto bemaase yadecha habberurin.
Amar rabbi yochanan: kol yamav shel oto tzaddik, haya mitztaer al mikra ze: "shir hammaalot beshuv Adonai et shivat tziyyon hayinu kecholmim", amar: mi ikka denayem shivin shenin bechelma?

Yoma chad hava azel beorcha, chazyeh lehahu gavra dahava nata charuva, amar leh: hay, ad kamma shenin taen? amar leh: ad shivin shenin. amar leh: peshita lach dechayet shivin shenin? amar leh: ana charuva bealma ashkecheh. ki hechi dishtalu li avahati — shetali name livrai.

Yatev, ka karech rifta, atay leh shinta, nim. ahdara leh meshshunnita, ikkassi meena, venim shivin shenin. ki kam, chazyeh lehahu gavra dehu ka melakket minnayyhu, amar leh: at hu dishtalteh? amar leh: bar bereh ana. amar leh: shema minna dinyaymi shivin shenin. chaza lachamar[te]y deityeylida lay ramche ramche.

Azal leveteh amar lehu: bereh dechoni hameaggel mi kayyaym? amaru leh: bereh lete, bar bereh ite. amar lehu: ana choni hameaggel. la hemnuhu. azal levet hammidrash, shaminhu lerabbanan dekaamri: nehiran shematatin kevishne choni hameaggel, dechi have ayel levet midresha — kol kusheya dahavo lehu lerabbanan hava mefarek lehu. amar lehu: ana nihu, vela hemnuhu, vela avdi leh yekara kidmibbee leh. chalash dateh, bea rachame, umit. amar rava: hayeynu deamri inashe: o chavruta o mituta.

Abba chilkiyya bar bereh dechoni hameaggel hava, vechi mitzterich alma lemitra havo meshadderi rabbanan legabbeh uvae rachame, veate mitra. zimna chada itzterich alma lemitra, shaddur rabbanan zuga derabbanan legabbeh lemive rachame denete mitra. azul leveteh vela ashkechuhv, azul bedavra veashkechu dahava ka rafek, yehavu leh shelama
b: Vela asbar lehu appeh. befanya, ki hava menakket tzive, dera tzive umara bechad katpa, ugelima bechad katpa. kulla orcha la sayem mesane, ki mate lemayya sayem mesaneh. ki meta lehizme vehige dallinhu lemaneh. ki meta lemata, nafka devethu leappeh ki mikkashsheta. ki meta leveteh, allat devethu beresha, vahadar ayel ihu, vahadar ayyli rabbanan. yetev ucherech rifta vela amar lehu lerabbanan tu keruchu. pelag rifta leyanoke, lekashshisha — chada, ulezutera — tere.

Amar la lidvethu: yadana derabbanan mishshum mitra ka atu, nissak leiggara venive rachame, efshar demiratztze hakkadosh baruch hu veyete mitra vela nachzek tevuta lenafshin. saku leiggara, kam ihu bachada zavita, veihi bachada zavita, kedum seluk anane mehach zavita didvethu. ki nachet amar lehu: ammay ato rabbanan? amaru leh: shaddaru lan rabbanan legabbe demar lemive rachame ammitra. amar lehu: baruch hammakom shello hitzrich etchem leabba chilkiyya.

Amaru leh: yadinan demitra mechamat mar hu daata, ella lema lan mar hane mille ditmiha lan: may tama ki yahevna lemar shelama la asbar lan mar appeh? amar lehu: sechir yom havay, veamena: la eppaggar. umay tama dera mar tzive achad katpeh ugelima achad katpeh? amar lehu: tallit sheula hayta. lehachi sheali, ulehachi la sheali.

May tama kulla orcha la sayem mar mesaneh vechi mate lemayya sayem mesaneh? amar lehu: kulla orcha chazena, bemayya la ka chazena. may tama ki meta mar lehizme vehige dallinhu lemaneh? amar lehu: ze maale arucha, veze eno maale arucha.

May tama ki meta mar lemata nafka devethu demar ki mikkashsheta? amar lehu: kede shello etten enay beishsha acheret. may tama ayyla hi beresha, vahadar ayel mar abbatra, vahadar ayylinan anan? amar lehu mishshum dela bedikitu li.

May tama ki karech mar rifta la amar lan "eto keruchu"? mishshum dela nefisha rifta, veamena: la achzek behu berabbanan tevuta bechinnam. may tama yehev mar leyanoka kashshisha chada rifta ulezutera tere? amar lehu: hay — kae beveta, vehay — yatev beve chenishta.

Umay tama keduym seluk anane mehach zavita dahavot kayyma devethu demar laanana dideh? mishshum deitteta shechicha beveta, veyahava rifta laaniyye, umekarva hanayayta. vaana yahevna zuza, vela mekarva hanayayteh. i name: hanhu biryone dehavu beshivavutan, ana bae rachame delemutu, vehi baaya rachame delihderu bityuveta [vahadaru].

Chanan hannechba bar beratte dechoni hameaggel hava, ki mitzterich alma lemitra, havo meshadderi rabbanan yanoke deve rav legabbeh venakti leh beshippule gelimeh, vaamaru leh: abba, abba, hav lan mitra! amar lifne hakkadosh baruch hu: ribbono shel olam! ase bishvil ellu, sheen makkirin ben abba deyahev mitra, leabba dela yahev mitra. veammay kare leh "chanan hannechba" — mippene shehaya machbi atzmo bevet hakkisse.

Amar leh rabbi zerika lerav safra: ta chazi ma ben takkife deara deyisrael lachaside devavel. chaside devavel rav huna verav chisda, ki hava mitzterich alma lemitra amri: nikkannef hadade venive rachame, efshar demiratztze hakkadosh baruch hu deyete mitra.

Takkife deara deyisrael kegon rabbi yona avu derabbi mani, ki hava mitzterich alma lemitra, hava ayel leveteh vaamar lehu: havu li gualki, veezil veayyte li bezuza ivura. ki hava nafek levara, azel vekae beducheta ammikta, dichtiv: "mimmaamakkim keraticha Adonai", vekae beducheta tzenia, umikkasse besakka, uvae rachame, veate mitra. ki hava ate leveteh, amri leh: ayyti mar ivura? amar lehu: amena, hoil vaata mitra, hasheta ravavch alma.

Vetu, rabbi mani bereh havo ka metzaari leh deve nesia. ishtattach al kivra daavu, amar leh: abba abba! hane metzaaru li. yoma chad havo ka chalfi hatam, innekut kara desusavotayyhu ad dekabbilu alayyhu dela ka metzaaru leh.
Vetu: rabbi mani hava shechiach kammeh derabbi yitzchak ben elyashiv, amar leh: attire deve chami ka metzaaru li. amar: liano, veiano. amar: ka dachaku li. amar: liatteru, veiattaru.

Amar: la mikkabbeli alay inashe beti. amar leh: ma shema? channa. tityaypi channa. venityaypet. amar leh: ka miggandera alay. amar leh: i hachi tachzor channa leshachruritah, vechazra channa leshachruritah.
Hanhu tere talmide dahavo kammeh derabbi yitzchak ben elyashiv, amaru leh: nive mar rachame alan denichachem tuva. amar lehu: immi hayta, ushelachtiha.
Rabbi yose bar avin hava shechiach kammeh derabbi yose demin yokeret. shivkeh, vaata lekammeh derav ashe.

a: Yoma chad shameh deka gares, amar shemuel: hashshole dag min hayyam beshabbat, kevan sheyyavash bo kesela — chayyayv. amar leh: velema mar uven senappirav! amar leh: vela savar la mar dehahi rabbi yose ben rabbi avin amra? amar leh: ana nihu.

Amar leh: velav kammeh derabbi yose demin yokeret hava shechiach mar? amar leh: hin. amar leh: umay tama shavkeh mar vaata hacha? amar leh: gavra deal bereh veal beratte la chas, alay didi hechi chayes?!

Bereh may hi? yoma chad havo agiri leh agire bedavra, nega lehu vela ayyti lehu rifta, amaru leh livreh: kafenan! havo yatvi tute teenta, amar: teena, teena! hotzii perotayich, veyochlu poale abba. appika vaachalu.

Addehachi vehachi ata avu amar lehu: la tinnaktu bedatayychu, dehay dingahna, ammitzva tarachna, vead hasheta hu desaggay. amaru leh: rachamana laysbeach ki hechi deasbean berach. amar lehu: mehecha? amaru: hachi vehachi hava maase. amar lo: beni, atta hitrachta et koncha lehotzi teena peroteha shello bizmannah — yeasef shello bizmanno.

Beratte may hi? haveya leh beratta baalat yofi, yoma chad chazye lehahu gavra dahava kare behutza veka chaze la. amar lo: may hay? amar leh: rabbi, im lelokchah lo zachiti — lirotah lo ezke? amar la: bitti, ka metzaarat lehu livriyyayta, shuvi leafrich veal yikkashlu bich bene adam.

Haveya leh hahu chamara, kedahavo agri la kol yoma, leureta havo meshadderi le agra aggabba, veatya leve mara, vei tafu la o batzri la — la atya. yoma chad innesho zuga desandale ala, vela azala ad deshaklunehu minna, vahadar azala.

Elazar ish birta, kad havo chazu leh gabbae tzedaka havo tashu minneh, dechol may dahava gabbeh yahev lehu. yoma chad hava salek leshuka lemizban neduneya livratteh, chazyu gabbae tzedaka, tesho minneh.

Azal urehat batrayyhu, amar lehu: ashbatichu bemay askitu? amaru leh: beyatom vitoma. amar lahen: haavoda shehen kodmin levitti. shekal kol dahava bahadeh vihav lehu. pash leh chad zuza, zevan leh chitte, veassek shadyeh baachalba.

Atay devethu amara la livratteh: may ayyti avuch? amara lah: kol ma deayyti, baachalba shediteh. atya lemiftach bava daachalba, chazat achalba demalya chitte veka nafka betzinnora dedashsha, vela mippetach bava mechitte. azala beratte leve midresha, amara leh: bo uree ma asa lecha ohavcha! amar la: haavoda, hare hen hekdesh alayich, veen lach bahen ella keechad meaniyye yisrael.

Rabbi yehuda nesia gezar taanita, bea rachame vela ata mitra. amar: kamma ikka mishshemuel haramati lihuda ben gamliel! oy lo laddor shekken nitka, oy lo lemi shealta beyamav kach! chalash dateh vaata mitra.
Deve nesia gezar taanita, vela odinhu lerabbi yochanan uleresh lakish. letzafra odinhu. amar leh resh lakish lerabbi yochanan: ha la kabbelna alan meureta! amar leh: anan batrayyhu geririnan.
Deve nesia gezar taanita vela ata mitra. tena lehu oshaya zeera demin chavrayyay: "vehaya im meene haeda neesta lishgaga".
Mashal lechalla shehi bevet aviha. kol zeman sheeneha yafot — en kol gufah tzericha bedika. eneha terutot — kol gufah tzericha bedika.

Ato avdeh uremo leh sudara betzavvereh, veka metzaaru leh. amaru lehu bene mateh: shivkeh, deha name metzaar lan. kevan dachazenan dechol milleh leshum shamayim, la amrinan leh midde veshavkinan leh, attun name shivku.

Rabbi gezar taanita vela ata mitra. nechet kammeh ilfa (veamri la rabbi ilfe), amar "mashshiv haruach" uneshav zika, "morid haggeshem" vaata mitra. amar leh: may ovadach? amar leh: dayayrna bekuseta dechika delet beh chamra lekiddusha veavdalta. tarachna (veatena) [umayytena] chamra lekiddusha veavdalta, umappekna lehu yede chovtayyhu.

Rav ikkela lehahu atra, gezar taanita vela ata mitra. nechet kammeh shelicha detzibbura, amar "mashshiv haruach" uneshav zika, amar "morid haggeshem" vaata mitra. amar leh: may ovadach? amar leh: maykre dardeke ana, umakrena livne anye kivne attire. vechol dela efshar leh — la shakelyna minneh midde. veit li pira dichvore, vechol man defasha meshachedna leh minnayyhu, umesadderinan leh umefayyeysinan leh ad deate vekare.
Rav nachman gezar taanita, bea rachame vela ata mitra, amar: shaklu lenachman, chavutu min gudda leara. chalash dateh vaata mitra.

Rabba gezar taanita, bea rachame vela ata mitra. amaru leh: veha rav yehuda ki hava gazar taanita ata mitra. amar lehu: may eeved? i mishshum tannoye — anan adifinan minnayyhu, devishne derav yehuda kol tannoye
b: Binzikin hava, vaanan ka matnenan beshitta sidrin. vechi hava mate rav yehuda beuketzin "haishsha shekkoveshet yarak bikdera", veamri la: "zetim shekkevashan betarfehen tehorin", amar: havayyot derav ushemuel ka chazena hacha,

Vaanan ka matnenan beuketzin telesar metivata. veillu rav yehuda, ki hava shalef chad mesana — ate mitra, vaanan ka tzavvchinan kulle yoma velekka deashgach ban. i mishshum ovada, i ikka dachaza midde — lema, aval ma yaasu gedole haddor sheen doran dome yafe.

Rav yehuda chaza hanhu be tere dahavo ka partzi berifta, amar: shema minna ikka siva bealma, yehev eneh — hava kafna. amaru leh rabbanan lerav kahana bereh derav nechuneya shammaeh: mar dishchiach kammeh, niasseyeh delippok befitcha desamuch leshuka. asseyeh unefak leshuka, chaza kinnufeya,

Amar lehu: may hay? amaru leh: akkusepa detamre kayymi deka mizdabban. amar: shema minna kafna bealma, amar leh leshammaeh: shelof li mesanayy. shelaf leh chad mesana vaata mitra. ki meta lemishlaf acharina, ata eliyyahu vaamar leh: amar hakkadosh baruch hu: i shalfat acharina — machrevna lealma.

Amar rav mari bera devat shemuel: ana hava kaemna aggudda dinhar pappa, chazay lemalache deiddemo lemallache deka mayyti chala umelonhu learbe, vahava kimcha dismida. ato kulle alma lemizban, amena lehu: meha la tizbenun demaase nissim hu, limchar atyayn arve dechitte defarzina.

Rava ikkela lehageronya, gezar taanita vela ata mitra. amar lehu: bitu kulle alma betaanitayychu. limchar amar lehu: mi ikka dachaza chelma — lema. amar lehu rabbi elazar mehageronya, ledidi akreyun bechelmay: shelam tav lerav tav meribbon tav, demittuveh metev leammeh. amar: shema minna et ratzon hi (mive rachame). beo rachame veate mitra.

Hahu gavra deichayyayv negada beve dina derava mishshum dival nochrit. naggedeh rava umit. ishtema milleta be shabbur malka, bea letzaore lerava. amara leh ifra hormiz immeh deshabbur malka livra: la leheve lach esek devarim bahade yehudae, dechol man devaayin mimmarayyhu yahev lehu.

Amar la: may hi? baayin rachame veate mitra. amar la: hahu mishshum dezimna demitra hu. ella livo rachame haiddana bitkufat tammuz, velete mitra. shelacha leh lerava: kavven datach uvei rachame delete mitra. bae rachame vela ate mitra.

Amar lefanav: ribbono shel olam! "elohim beoznenu shamanu avotenu sipperu lanu poal paalta vimehem bime kedem", veanu beenenu lo rainu! ata mitra ad dishfuch marzeve demachoza lediglat. ata avu itchazi leh bechelmeh vaamar leh: mi ikka demaytrach kamme shemayya kulle hay? amar leh: shanni duchetaych. shanni ducheteh, limchar ashkecheh demirsham pureyeh besakkine.

Rav pappa gezar taanita vela ata mitra. chalash libbeh, seraf pinka dedayysa uvae rachame vela ata mitra. amar leh rav nachman bar ushepazti: i saref mar pinka achariti dedayysa ate mitra. ikkesif, vachalash dateh, vaata mitra.

Rabbi chanina ben dosa hava ka azel beorcha, ata mitra. amar lefanav: ribbono shel olam, kol haolam kullo benachat, vachanina betzaar! pesak mitra. ki meta leveteh, amar lefanav: ribbono shel olam, kol haolam kullo betzaar vachanina benachat? ata mitra.

Amar rav yosef: may ahneya leh tzelota dechohen gadol legabbe rabbi chanina ben dosa. ditnan: haya mitpallel tefilla ketzara babbayit hachitzon. may metzalle? ravin bar adda verava bar adda deamri tarvayyhu mishshemeh derav yehuda: yehi ratzon millefanecha Adonai elohenu shettehe hashshana hazzo geshuma ushechuna. shechuna meallayyta hi? adderabba, geriuta hi!

Ella: im shechuna — tehe geshuma utelula. veal yikkanes lefanecha tefillat ovre derachim. rav acha bereh derava mesayyem mishshemeh derav yehuda: la yide aved shuletan middevet yehuda, veal yehu ammecha yisrael tzerichin lehitparnes ze mizze, velo leam acher.

Amar rav yehuda amar rav: bechol yom veyom bat kol yotzet veomeret: kol haolam kullo nizzon bishvil chanina beni, vachanina beni dayyo bekav charuvim meerev shabbat leerev shabbat. hava regila devethu lemechama tannura kol maale deshabbeta veshadyay aktarta

a: Mishshum kissufa. hava la hach shivavta bishta, amara: mikkede yadana delet lehu vela midde, may kulle hay? azala uterafa abbava, ikkasfa vaayayla leinderona,

Itavid la nissa dechazya letannura mele lachma veaggana mele lesha, amara la: pelanita, pelanita! ayytay masa, deka charich lachmich. amara lah: af ana lehachi ayayli. tana: af hi lehavi marde nichnesa, mippene shemmelummedet benissim.

Amara leh devethu: ad emat nezil venitztaar kulle hay? amar la: may naaved? bei rachame denittevu lach midde. bea rachame, yatzta kemin pissat yad vihavu leh chad kara defatura dedahava. chazya bechelma, atidi tzaddike deachli appatura dedahava deit leh telat kare, veihu — appatura ditre kare.

Amar la: nicha lach demechol achli kulle alma appatura demashlam vaanan appatura dimchassar. amara leh: umay naaved? bei rachame denishkelinhu minnach. bae rachame veshakluhu. tana: gadol haya nes acharon yoter min harishon. digmiri, demehav yahavi mishkal la shakli.

Chad be shimshe chazyay levarteh dahavot atziva, amar la: bitti ammay atzivat? amara leh: keli shel chometz nitchallef li bichli shel shemen vehidlakti mimmennu ur leshabbat. amar la: bitti, may ichpat lich? mi sheamar lashshemen veyidlok, hu yomar lachometz veyidlok. tana: haya dolek veholech kol hayyom kullo, ad sheheviu mimmennu ur lehavedala.

Rabbi chanina ben dosa havo leh hanach izze, amaru leh: ka mafsedan. amar: i ka mafsedan — nechlinhu dubbe, vei la — kol chada vachada tayte leureta dubba bekarnayyhu. leureta ayytay kol chada vachada dubba bekarnayyhu.
Hava leh hahi shivavta deka vanya beta vela meto keshure. atya lekammeh, amara leh: beneti beti vela kamatu keshuray. amar la: ma shemich? amara leh: echu. amar: echu nimto keshurich.

Tana: higgiu ad sheyyatzu amma lechan veamma lechan. veyesh omrin: senifin asaum. tanya, pelemo omer: ani raiti oto habbayit, vehayu korotav yotzot amma lechan veamma lechan, veamru li: bayit ze shekkera rabbi chanina ben dosa bitfillato.

Verabbi chanina ben dosa mehechan havo leh izzim? veha ani have! veod, amru chachamim: en megaddelin behema dakka beeretz yisrael? amar rav pinchas: maase veavar adam echad al petach beto vehinniach sham tarnegolin, umetzaatan ishto shel rabbi chanina ben dosa,

Veamar lah: al tochli mibbetzehen. vehirbu betzim vetarnegolin vehayu metzaarin otam, umecharan vekana bidmehen izzim. paam achat avar oto adam sheavdu mimmennu hattarnegolin veamar lachavero: bechan hinnachti hattarnegolin shelli. shama rabbi chanina, amar lo: yesh lecha bahen siman? amar lo: hen. natan lo siman venatal et haizzin, vehen hen izze deayyto dubbe bekarnayyhu.

Rabbi elazar ben pedat dechika leh milleta tuva. avad milleta vela hava leh midde lemitam, shekal bera detuma veshadyeh befummeh, chalash libbeh venim. azul rabbanan leshayyole beh, chazyu deka vache vechayech, unefak tzutzita denura meapputeh.

Ki ittear, amaru leh: may tama kavachet vechayychat? amar lehu: dahava yatev immi hakkadosh baruch hu, vaamari leh: ad matay etztaar behay alma? vaamar li: elazar beni, nicha lach deefcheh lealma meresha, efshar demityalledat beshata dimzone.
Amari lekammeh: kulle hay, veefshar? amari leh: dachayay tefe o dechayena? amar li: dachayet. amari lekammeh: im ken, la baena.

Amar li: behay agra daamart "la baena" yahevna lach lealma deate telesre nahravota demishcha afarsemon dachayin kifrat vediglat, demiannegat behu. amari lekammeh: hay vetu la? amar li: ulechavrach may yahevna? amari leh: vaana miggavra delet leh baena? machyayn beiskutela apputay, vaamar li: elazar beri, garo bach giray.

Rabbi chama bar chanina gezar taanita vela ata mitra. amaru leh: veha rabbi yehoshua ben levi gazar taanita veate mitra! amar lehu: ha ana, ha bar levay. amaru leh: denete venichavven datin, efshar detavri tzibbura libbayyhu deate mitra. beon rachame vela ate mitra.
Amar lehu: nicha lechu sheyyavo matar bishvilenu? amaru leh: hen. amar: rakia rakia kasse panecha! la ikkassi. amar: kamma azzin pene rakia, ikkassi vaata mitra.

Levi gezar taanita vela ata mitra. amar lefanav: ribbono shel olam! alita veyashavta bammarom veen atta merachem al banecha. ata mitra, veittela. amar rabbi elazar: leolam al yatiach adam devarim kelappe mala, shehare adam gadol hetiach devarim kelappe mala veittela, umannu — levi.
Ha gerama leh? veha levi achvi kidda kammeh derabbi, veittela! ha veha gerama leh.

Rabbi chiyyay bar luleyayni shaminhu lehanach anane dekaamri: neto venishde mayya beammon umoav. amar lefanav: ribbono shel olam! keshennatatta tora leammecha yisrael chizzarta al kol ummot haolam velo kibbeluha, veachshav atta noten lahem matar? shedo hacha. shadyu adduchetayhu.

Daresh rabbi chiyyay bar luleyayni, may dichtiv: "tzaddik kattamar yifrach keerez ballevanon yisge", im neemar tamar lamma neemar erez, veim neemar erez lamma neemar tamar? illu neemar tamar velo neemar erez, hayiti omer: ma tamar
b: En gizo machlif, af tzaddik chas veshalom en gizo machlif — lechach neemar erez. illu neemar erez velo neemar tamar, hayiti omer: ma erez en ose perot af tzaddik chas veshalom en ose perot — lechach neemar tamar veneemar erez.

Veerez gizo machlif? vehatanya: hallokeach ilan mechavero lakotz, magbiho min hakkarka tefach vekotzetz. besaddan hashshikma — shene tefachim. bivtulat hashshikma — shelosha tefachim. bekanim uvigfanim — min happekak ulemala. bidkalim uvaarazim — chofer lematta umashrish, lefi sheen gizo machlif.
Hacha bemay askinan bishar mine arazim, kidrabba bar huna. deamar rabba bar huna: asara mine arazim hen, shenneemar: "etten bammidbar erez shitta vahadas vegomer".

Tanu rabbanan: maase berabbi eliezer sheggazar shelosh esre taaniyyot al hatztzibbur velo yardu geshamim, baacharona hitchilu hatztzibbur latzet. amar lahem: tikkantem kevarim leatzmechem?! gau kol haam bivchiyya, veyardu geshamim.

Shuv maase berabbi eliezer sheyyarad lifne hatteva, veamar esrim vearba berachot velo naana. yarad rabbi akiva acharav veamar: "avinu malkenu en lanu melech ella atta. avinu malkenu, lemaancha rachem alenu", veyardu geshamim. havo meranneni rabbanan, yatzta bat kol veamra: lo mippene shezze gadol mizze, ella shezze maavir al middotav, veze eno maavir al middotav.

Tanu rabbanan: ad matay yehu haggeshamim yordin vehatztzibbur poskin mittaanitam? kimlo berech hammacharesha, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim: bachareva tefach, bevenonit tifchayim, baavuda shelosha tefachim.
Tanya, rabbi shimon ben elazar omer: en lecha tefach millemala, sheen tehom yotze likrato shelosha tefachim. veha tanya tifchayim! la kashya: kan baavuda, kan besheenah avuda.
Amar rabbi elazar: keshemmenassechin et hammayim bechag, tehom omer lachavero: abba memecha, kol shene reim ani shomea. shenneemar: "tehom el tehom kore lekol tzinnorecha vegomer".

Amar rabba: ledidi chaze li hay ridya, dame leigla uferita sifvoteh vekayyma ben tehoma tattaa lithoma illaa. lithoma illaa amar leh: chashor memecha. lithoma tattaa amar leh: abba memecha, shenneemar: "hannitztzanim niru baaretz vegomer".

Hayu mitannin veyardu geshamim kodem hanetz hachamma kulei. tanu rabbanan: hayu mitannin veyardu lahem geshamim, kodem hanetz hachamma — lo yashlimu. leachar hanetz hachamma — yashlimu, divre rabbi meir. rabbi yehuda omer: kodem chatzot — lo yashlimu. leachar chatzot — yashlimu.

Rabbi yose omer: kodem tesha shaot — lo yashlimu, leachar tesha shaot — yashlimu, shekken matzinu beachav melech yisrael shehitanna mittesha shaot ulemala, shenneemar: "haraita ki nichna achav vegomer".

Rabbi yehuda nesia gezar taanita veyardu lahem geshamim leachar hanetz hachamma. savar leashlominhu, amar leh rabbi amme: kodem chatzot veachar chatzot shaninu. shemuel hakkatan gezar taanita veyardu lahem geshamim kodem hanetz hachamma. kisvurin haam lomar: shivcho shel tzibbur hu.
Amar lahem: emshol lachem mashal, lema haddavar dome — leeved shemvakkesh peras merabbo, amar lahem: tenu lo veal eshma kolo.

Shuv, shemuel hakkatan gezar taanita veyardu lahem geshamim leachar shekiat hachamma. kisvurim haam lomar shivcho shel tzibbur hu, amar lahem shemuel: lo shevach shel tzibbur hu, ella emshol lachem mashal, lema haddavar dome — leeved shemvakkesh peras merabbo, veamar lahem: hametinu lo ad sheyyitmakmek veyitztaer, veachar kach tenu lo.
Velishmuel hakkatan shivcho shel tzibbur hechi dame? amar "mashshiv haruach" uneshav zika, amar "morid haggeshem" vaata mitra.
Maase vegazru taanit belod kulei. venema hallel meikkara? abbaye verava deamri tarvavyyhu: lefi sheen omrim hallel

a: Ella al nefesh sevea vechares melea. ini? veha rav pappa ikkela leve kenishta daavi govar ugezar taanit, veyardu lahem geshamim ad chatzot, veamar [lahem: imru] hallel veachar kach ichlu ushetu! shane bene machoza, dishchichi behu shichrut.
Hadaran alach seder taaniyyot ellu
Bishlosha perakim beshana kohanim nosin et kappehen arba peamim bayyom; bashshacharit, bammusaf, bammincha, uvinilat shearim: betaaniyyot, uvemaamadot, uveyom hakkippurim.
Ellu hen maamadot. lefi shenneemar: "tzav et bene yisrael et korbani lachmi", vechi heach korbano shel adam karev vehu eno omed al gabbav?
Hitkinu neviim harishonim esrim vearbaa mishmarot, al kol mishmar umishmar haya maamad birushalayim shel kohanim shel leviyyim veshel yisreelim.

Higgia zeman hammishmar laalot, kohanim uleviyyim olim lirushalayim, veyisrael shebbeoto mishmar mitkannesin learehen, vekorin bemaase vereshit. veanshe hammaamad hayu mitannin arbaa yamim bashshavua miyyom sheni vead yom chamishi. velo hayu mitannin erev shabbat — mippene kevod hashshabbat, velo beechad beshabbat — kede shello yetzu mimmenucha veoneg ligia vetaanit veyamutu.

Bayyom harishon: bereshit, vihi rakia. bashsheni: yehi rakia, veyikkavu hammayim. bashshelishi: yikkavu hammayim, vihi meorot. barvii: yehi meorot, veyishretzu hammayim. bachamishi: yishretzu hammayim, vetotze haaretz. bashshishshi: totze haaretz, vaychullu hashshamayim.

Parasha gedola korin otah bishnayim, vehakketanna beyachid. bashshacharit uvammusaf. uvammincha nichnasin vekorin al pihen, kekorin et shema. erev shabbat bammincha lo hayu nichnasin — mippene kevod hashshabbat.
Kol yom sheyyesh bo hallel — en maamad bashshacharit, korban musaf — en banneila, korban etzim — en bammincha. divre rabbi akiva.
Amar lo ben azzay, kach haya rabbi yehoshua shone: korban musaf — en bammincha, korban etzim — en banneila. chazar rabbi akiva lihyot shone keven azzay.

Zeman atze chohanim vehaam, tisha: beechad benisan bene arach ben yehuda, beesrim betammuz bene david ben yehuda, bachamishsha beav bene farosh ben yehuda, beshiva bo bene yonadav ben rechav, baasara bo bene senaa ben binyamin, bachamishsha asar bo bene zattu ben yehuda.
Veimmahem kohanim uleviyyim, vechol mi shettaa beshivto, uvene gonve eli uvene kotze ketziot.

Beesrim bo bene pachat moav ben yehuda, beesrim beelul bene adin ben yehuda, beechad betevet shavu bene farosh sheniyya. beechad betevet lo haya bo maamad, shehaya bo hallel vekorban musaf vekorban etzim.
Chamishsha devarim eru et avotenu beshiva asar betammuz, vachamishsha betisha beav. beshiva asar betammuz
b: Nishtabberu halluchot, uvatal hattamid, vehuveka hair, vesaraf appostemos et hattora, veheemid tzelem bahechol.
Betisha beav nigzar al avotenu shello yikkansu laaretz, vecharav habbayit barishona uvashsheniyya, venilkeda better, venechresha hair.

Mishshennichnas av memaatin besimcha. shabbat shechal tisha beav lihyot betochah asur millesapper umillechabbes, uvachamishi muttarin mippene kevod hashshabbat. erev tisha beav lo yochal adam shene tavshilin, lo yochal basar velo yishte yayin. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: yeshanne. rabbi yehuda mechayyev bichfiyyayt hammitta, velo hodu lo chachamim.

Amar rabban shimon ben gamliel: lo hayu yamim tovim leyisrael kachamishsha asar beav ucheyom hakkippurim, shebbahen benot yerushalayim yotzot bichle lavan sheulin — shello levayyesh et mi sheen lo. kol hakkelim teunin tevila.

Uvenot yerushalayim yotzot vecholot bakkeramim. uma hayu omrot: bachur, sa na enecha uree ma atta borer lach. al titten enecha bannoy, ten enecha bammishpacha. "sheker hachen vehevel hayyofi ishsha yirat Adonai hi tithallal", veomer: "tenu lah mipperi yadeha vihalluha vashshearim maaseha".

Vechen hu omer: "tzeena ureena benot tziyyon bammelech shelomo baatara sheittera lo immo beyom chatunnato uveyom simchat libbo". "beyom chatunnato" — ze mattan tora, "uveyom simchat libbo" — ze binyan bet hammikdash, sheyyibbane bimhera beyamenu.

Gemara bishlosha perakim bashshana kohanim nosin et kappehem kulei. taaniyyot umaamadot mi ikka musaf? chassore michassera, vehachi katane: bishlosha perakim kohanim nosin et kappehen kol zeman shemmitpallelin, veyesh mehen arbaa peamim bayyom — shacharit umusaf mincha uneilat shearim, veellu hen shelosha perakim: taaniyyot, umaamadot, veyom hakkippurim.
Amar rav nachman amar rabba bar avu: zo divre rabbi meir. aval chachamim omrim: shacharit umusaf — yesh bahen nesiat kappayim, mincha uneila — en bahen nesiat kappayim.

Man chachamim — rabbi yehuda hi. detanya: shacharit umusaf mincha uneila kullan yesh bahen nesiat kappayim, divre rabbi meir. rabbi yehuda omer: shacharit umusaf — yesh bahen nesiat kappayim, mincha uneila — en bahen nesiat kappayim. rabbi yose omer: neila — yesh bah nesiat kappayim, mincha — en bah nesiat kappayim.
Bemay kamippalgi? rabbi meir savar: kol yoma tama may la parsi kahane yedayyhu beminchata — mishshum shichrut, haiddana lekka shichrut.
Rabbi yehuda savar: shacharit umusaf dechol yoma la shechiach shichrut — la gezaru behu rabbanan, mincha uneila dechol yoma shechicha shichrut — gezaru behu rabbanan.
Rabbi yose savar: mincha deita bechol yoma — gezaru ba rabbanan, neila deleta bechol yoma — la gezaru ba rabbanan.
Amar rav yehuda amar rav: halacha kerabbi meir. verabbi yochanan amar: nahagu haam kerabbi meir. verava amar: minhag kerabbi meir.
Man deamar halacha kerabbi meir — darshinan la befirka. man deamar minhag — midrash la darshinan, oroye morenan. uman deamar nahagu — oroye la morenan, vei aved — aved, vela mahderinan leh.
Verav nachman amar: halacha kerabbi yose. vahalacha kerabbi yose. vehaiddana may tama parsi kahane yedayyhu beminchata detaanita? kevan divsamuch lishkiat hachamma ka parsi — kitfillat neila damya.

Dechulle alma mihat shikkor asur binsiat kappayim. menahane mille? amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi mishshum bar kappara: lamma nismecha parashat kohen mevarech lefarashat nazir? lomar: ma nazir asur beyayin, af kohen mevarech asur beyayin.

Matkef la avu derabbi zera, veamri la oshaya bar zavda: i ma nazir asur bechartzan — af kohen mevarech asur bechartzan! amar rabbi yitzchak, amar kera: "lesharto ulevarech bishmo", ma mesharet muttar bechartzan — af kohen mevarech muttar bechartzan.

a: I ma mesharet — baal mum la, af kohen mevarech — baal mum la! ha ittakkash lenazir.
Umay chazet demakkeshat lekulla? akkesh lechumera! asmachta ninhu midderabbanan, ulekulla.

Ellu hen maamadot. lefi shenneemar: "tzav et bene yisrael kulei". may kaamar? hachi kaamar: ellu hen maamadot. uma taam tikkenu maamadot, lefi shenneemar: "tzav et bene yisrael veamarta alehem et korbani lachmi leishshay".

Veheach korbano shel adam karev vehu eno omed al gabbav? hitkinu neviim harishonim esrim vearbaa mishmarot. al kol mishmar umishmar haya maamad birushalayim shel kohanim veshel leviyyim veshel yisreelim. higgia zeman mishmar laalot, kohanim uleviyyim olin lirushalayim.

Tanu rabbanan: esrim vearbaa mishmarot beeretz yisrael, ushetem esre biricho. shetem esre biricho?! nefishan lehu tuva! ella: shetem esre mehen biricho. higgia zeman hammishmar laalot, chatzi hammishmar haya ole meeretz yisrael lirushalayim, vachatzi hammishmar haya ole miricho, kede sheyyesappeku mayim umazon laachehem shebbirushalayim.

Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: kohanim uleviyyim veyisreelim meakkevin et hakkorban. bematnita tana rabbi shimon ben elazar: kohanim uleviyyim uchele shir meakkevin et hakkorban. bemay kamippalgi? mar savar: ikkar shira bappe, umar savar: ikkar shira bichli.

Amar rav chama bar gureya amar rav: moshe tikken lahem leyisrael shemona mishmarot, arbaa meelazar vearbaa meitamar. ba shemuel veheemidan al shesh esre, ba david veheemidan al esrim vearbaa, shenneemar: "bishnat haarbaim lemalchut david nidrashu vayyimmatze vahem gibbore chayil beyazer gilad".

Metivi: moshe tikken lahem leyisrael shemona mishmarot, arbaa meelazar vearbea meitamar, uva david ushemuel veheemidan al esrim vearba, shenneemar: "hemma yissad david ushemuel haroe beemunatam"! hachi kaamar: miyyissudo shel david ushemuel haramati heemidum al esrim vearba.

Tanya iddach: moshe tikken lahem leyisrael shesh esre mishmarot, shemona meelazar ushemona meitamar. uchesherabbu bene elazar al bene itamar, chillekum veheemidum al esrim vearba, shenneemar: "vayyimmatzu vene elazar rabbim lerashe haggevarim min bene itamar vayyachlekum livne elazar rashim levet avot shishsha asar velivne itamar levet avotam shemona", veomer: "bet av echad achuz leelazar veachuz achuz leitamar".

May "veomer"? vechi tema: ki hechi dinfishi bene elazar, hacha name dinfishi bene itamar — shemona, meikkara arbaa havo, ta shema: "bet av echad achuz leelazar veachuz achuz leitamar". teyuveta derav chama bar gureya!
Amar lecha rav chama bar gureya: tannae hi, vaana daamari ki hay tanna deamar shemona.
Tanu rabbanan: arbaa mishmarot alu min haggola, veellu hen: yedaya, charim, pashchur, veimmer. amdu neviim shebbenehem,
b: Vechillekum veheemidum al esrim vearbaa, belalum unetanum bekalpi. ba yedaya venatal chelko vechelek chaverav shesh, ba charim venatal chelko vechelek chaverav shesh, vechen pashchur, vechen immer.
Vechen hitnu neviim shebbenehem: sheafillu yehoyariv rosh mishmeret ole — lo yiddache yedaya mimmekomo. ella yedaya ikkar, vihoyariv tafel lo.

Veyisrael shebbeoto mishmar mitkannesin bearehen vekorin bemaase vereshit. menahane mille? amar rabbi yaakov bar acha amar rav assi: ilmale maamadot lo nitkayyeymu shamayim vaaretz, shenneemar: "vayyomer Adonai elohim bamma eda ki irashenna",

Amar avraham: ribbono shel olam! shemma yisrael chotin lefanecha, atta ose lahem kedor hammabbul uchedor happelagga? amar leh: lav. amar lefanav: ribbono shel olam! hodieni bamme irashenna? amar leh: "kecha li egla meshulleshet veez meshulleshet vegomer".

Amar lefanav: ribbono shel olam! tinach bizman shebbet hammikdash kayyaym. bizman sheen bet hammikdash kayyaym ma tehe alehem? amar lo: kevar tikkanti lahem seder korbanot, bizman shekkorin bahen lefanay — maale ani alehem keillu hikrivum lefanay vaani mochel lahem al kol avonotehem.

Tanu rabbanan: anshe mishmar hayu mitpallelin al korban achehem sheyyitkabbel beratzon. veanshe maamad mitkannesin levet hakkeneset, veyoshvin arba taaniyyot: bashsheni bashshabbat, bashshelishi, barvii, uvachamishi. bashsheni — al yorde hayyam. bashshelishi — al holche midbarot.

Barvii — al askara shello tippol al hattinokot. bachamishi — al ubbarot umenikot. ubbarot — shello yappilu, menikot — sheyyaniku et benehem. uvaerev shabbat lo hayu mitannin mippene kevod hashshabbat, kal vachomer bashshabbat atzmah.
Beechad beshabbat may tama la? amar rabbi yochanan: mippene hannotzrim. rabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar: mippene shehu shelishi laytzira.

Resh lakish amar: mippene neshama yetera, deamar resh lakish: neshama yetera nittena bo baadam beerev shabbat, bemotzae shabbat notlin otah mimmennu, shenneemar: "shavat vayyinnafash". kevan sheshshavat — vay avda nafesh.

Bayyom harishon "bereshit" vihi rakia". tana: "bereshit" bishnayim, "yehi rakia" beechad. bishlama "yehi rakia" beechad — telata pesuke havu. ella "bereshit" bishnayim, may tama? chamsha pesuke havayin, vetanya: hakkore battora — al yifchot mishshelosha pesukim!
Rav amar: doleg. ushemuel amar: posek. verav deamar doleg, may tama la amar posek? kasavar: kol pesuka dela paskeh moshe — anan la paskinan leh.

Ushemuel amar posek, umi paskinan? vehaamar rabbi chanina kara: tzaar gadol haya li etzel rabbi chanina haggadol velo hittir li lifsok ella letinokot shel bet rabban, hoil ulehitlammed asuyin. ushemuel — hatam tama may? mishshum dela efshar. hacha name la efshar.
Ushemuel amar posek, may tama la amar doleg? gezera mishshum hannichnasin ugezera mishshum hayyotzin.

Metivi: parasha shel shishsha pesukim — korin otah bishnayim, veshel chamishsha — beyachid. veim harishon kore shelosha, hashsheni kore shenayim mipparasha zo veechad mipparasha acheret. veyesh omrim: shelosha, lefi sheen matchilin bapparasha pachot mishshelosha pesukin.
Leman deamar doleg — lidlog, uleman deamar posek — lifsok! shane hatam,

a: Deit leh ravvcha.

Parasha gedola korin otah bishnayim bashshacharit uvammusaf. uvammincha korin al pihen kulei. ibbaya lehu: hechi kaamar? bashshacharit uvammusaf korin otah bassefer, uvammincha korin otah al pe kekorin et shema, o dilma hachi katane: bashshacharit korin otah bassefer, uvammusaf uvammincha korin otah al pe kekorin et shema?

Ta shema, detanya: bashshacharit uvammusaf nichnasin levet hakkeneset vekorin kederech shekkorin kol hashshana, uvammincha yachid kore otah al pe. amar rabbi yose: vechi yachid yachol likrot divre tora al pe betzibbur? ella kullan nichnasin vekorin otah al pe kekorin et shema.
Kol yom sheyyesh bo hallel en bo maamad kulei. ma hefresh ben ze laze? hallalu divre tora, vehallalu divre sofrim.
Zeman atze chohanim vehaam kulei. tanu rabbanan: lamma hutzerchu lomar zeman atze chohanim vehaam? amru: keshealu bene haggola lo matzu etzim ballishka, veamdu ellu vehitnaddevu mishshellahem.

Vechach hitnu neviim shebbenehen: sheafillu lishka melea etzim yihyu ellu mitnaddevin mishshellahen, shenneemar: "vehaggoralot hippalnu al kurban haetzim hakkohanim haleviyyim vehaam lehavi levet elohenu levet avotenu leittim mezummanim shana veshana levaer al mizbach Adonai elohenu kakkatuv battora".
Veimmahem kohanim uleviyyim vechol mi kulei. tanu rabbanan: ma hayu bene gonve eli uvene kotze ketziot?

Amru: paam achat gazra malchut harshaa shemad al yisrael shello yaviu etzim lammaaracha, veshello yaviu bikkurim lirushalayim, vehoshivu perozdaot al hadderachim kederech shehoshiv yarovam ben nevat, shello yaalu yisrael laregel.

Ma asu kesherin veyire chet shebbeoto haddor? heviu salle vikkurim vechippum biktziot unetalum, veeli al kitfehen. vechevan shehiggiu etzel perozdaot, amru lahem: lehechan attem holchin? omrin lahem: laasot shene iggule devela bammachteshet shellefanenu, uvaeli sheal ketefenu. kevan sheavru mehen — itterum besallim, vehevium lirushalayim.

Tana: hen hen bene salmay hannetofati. tanu rabbanan: ma hen bene salmay hannetofati? amru: paam achat gazra malchut harshaa shemad al yisrael shello yaviu etzim lammaaracha, vehoshivu perozdaot al hadderachim kederech shehoshiv yarovam ben nevat al hadderachim, shello yaalu yisrael laregel.

Ma asu yire chet shebbeoto haddor? heviu gezirehen veasu sullamot, vehinnichu al kitfehem vehalchu lahem. kevan shehiggiu etzlan, amru lahem: lehechan attem holchin? amru lahem: lehavi gozalot mishshovach shellefanenu uvassullamot sheal ketefenu. kevan sheavru mehen perkum vehevium veheelum lirushalayim.
Vaalehem veal kayyotze bahem hu omer: "zecher tzaddik livracha", veal yarovam ben nevat vachaverav neemar: "veshem reshaim yirkav".
Beesrim bo bene pachat moav ben yehuda. tana: bene pachat moav ben yehuda — hen hen bene david ben yehuda, divre rabbi meir. rabbi yose omer: hen hen bene yoav ben tzeruya.
Beesrim beelul bene adin ben yehuda vechulei. tanu rabbanan: bene adin ben yehuda — hen hen bene david ben yehuda, divre rabbi yehuda. rabbi yose omer: hen hen bene yoav ben tzeruya.
Beechad betevet shavu bene farosh sheniyya kulei. manni matnitin? la rabbi meir, vela rabbi yehuda, vela rabbi yose. i rabbi meir, litne: shavu bene david ben yehuda sheniyya!
I rabbi yehuda, litne: shavu bene david ben yehuda sheniyya! i rabbi yose, litne: shavu bene yoav ben tzeruya sheniyya!
Leolam rabbi yose, utere tannae allibba derabbi yose.
Beechad betevet lo haya bo maamad kulei. amar leh mar kashshisha bereh derav chisda lerav ashe:
b: May shena hallel dedache dideh, umay shena musaf dela dache dideh?
Amar leh rav ashe: hasheta delav dideh dache — dideh la kol shekken? amar leh, hachi kaamena lach: la lidche ella dideh!

Amar leh: ikka rabbi yose dekae kevotach. detanya, rabbi yose omer: kol yom sheyyesh bo musaf yesh bo maamad. maamad demay? ilema maamad deshacharit, ha tanna kamma name hachi kaamar! ella maamad demusaf — dideh name la dache?!
Ella demincha — korban etzim dache! ella lav, dinila. shema minna: dideh dache, delav dideh — la dache. shema minna.
Velitne name: beechad benisan lo haya bo maamad mippene sheyyesh bo hallel vekorban musaf vekorban etzim! amar rava: zot omeret hallela divresh yarcha lav deorayyta.

Deamar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi shimon ben yehotzadak: shemona asar yom bashshana yachid gomer bahen et hahallel, veellu hen: shemonat yeme hechag, ushemonat yeme chanukka, veyom tov harishon shel pesach, veyom tov shel atzeret. uvaggola, esrim veechad yom, veellu hen: tishat yeme hachag, ushemonat yeme chanukka, ushene yamim harishonim shel pesach, ushene yamim tovim shel atzeret.

Rav ikkela levavel, chazanhu deka karu hallela beresh yarcha, sevar leafsokinhu. kevan dachaza deka medallegi dalloge, amar: shema minna minhag avotehem bidehem. tana: yachid lo yatchil, veim hitchil gomer.

Chamishsha devarim eru et avotenu beshiva asar betammuz vechulei. nishtabberu halluchot, menalan? detanya: beshishsha lachodesh nittenu aseret haddibberot leyisrael, rabbi yose omer: beshiva bo. man deamar beshishsha nittenu — beshishsha nittenu, uveshiva ala moshe.

Man deamar beshiva — beshiva nittenu, uveshiva ala moshe, dichtiv: "vayyikra el moshe bayyom hashshevii", uchetiv: "vayyavo moshe betoch heanan vayyaal el hahar vayhi moshe bahar arbaim yom vearbaim layla". esrim vearbea desivan, veshittesar detammuz, melo lehu arbein.
Beshivsar betammuz nechet, ata vetavrinhu leluchot, uchetiv: "vayhi kaasher karav el hammachane vayyar et haegel vayyashlech miyyadav et halluchot vayshabber otam tachat hahar".
Batal hattamid — gemara.
Huveka hair. beshiva asar? vehachtiv: "bachodesh harvii betisha lachodesh vayyechezak haraav bair", uchetiv batreh: "vattibbaka hair vegomer"!
Amar rava, la kashya: kan — barishona, kan — bashsheniyya. detanya: barishona huveka hair betisha betammuz, bashsheniyya beshiva asar bo.
Saraf appostemos et hattora — gemara.
Heemid tzelem bahechol, menalan? dichtiv: "umeet husar hattamid velatet shikkutz shomem".
Vechad hava? vehachtiv: "veal kenaf shikkutzim meshomem"! amar rava: tere havo, unefal chad al chavreh vetavreh (leh) lideh, veishtechach dahava ketiv:

a: Ant tzevet l[a]cherove beta — yedach ashlemt leh.

Betisha beav nigzar al avotenu shello yikkansu laaretz, menalan — dichtiv: "vayhi bachodesh harishon bashshana hashshenit beechad lachodesh hukam hammishkan". veamar mar: shana rishona asa moshe et hammishkan, sheniyya hekim moshe et hammishkan, veshalach meraggelim. uchetiv: "vayhi bashshana hashshenit bachodesh hashsheni beesrim bachodesh naala heanan meal mishkan haedut".

Uchetiv: "vayyisu mehar Adonai derech sheloshet yamim". amar rabbi chama bar chanina: oto hayyom saru meachare Adonai. uchetiv: "vehasafsuf asher bekirbo hitauu taava vayyashuvu vayyivku gam bene yisrael vegomer", uchetiv: "ad chodesh yamim vegomer" —  dehavu lehu esrin vetarten besivan,
Uchetiv: "vattissager miryam shivat yamim" — dehavu lehu esrin vetisha besivan, uchetiv: "shelach lecha anashim",
Vetanya: beesrim vetisha besivan shalach moshe meraggelim, uchetiv: "vayyashuvu mittur haaretz mikketz arbaim yom". hane arbaim yom neche chad havu!
Amar abbaye: tammuz dehahi shatta malloye malleyu, dichtiv: "kara alay moed lishbor bachuray".

Uchetiv: "vattissa kol haeda vayyittenu et kolam vayyivku haam ballayla hahu", amar rabba amar rabbi yochanan: oto layla lel tisha beav haya. amar lahem hakkadosh baruch hu: attem bechitem bechiyya shel chinnam — vaani kovea lachem bechiyya ledorot.

Charav habbayit barishona, dichtiv: "uvachodesh hachamishi beshiva lachodesh hi shenat tesha esre shana lammelech nevuchadnetztzar melech bavel ba nevuzaradan rav tabbachim eved melech bavel yerushalam vayyisrof et bet Adonai vegomer", uchetiv: "uvachodesh hachamishi beasor lachodesh hi shenat tesha esre shana lammelech nevuchadnetztzar melech bavel ba nevuzaradan rav tabbachim amad lifne melech bavel birushalam vegomer".

Vetanya: i efshar lomar beshiva, shehare kevar neemar "beasor". vei efshar lomar beasor, shehare kevar neemar "beshiva", ha ketzad? beshiva nichnesu nochrim lahechol, veachlu vekilkelu bo shevii shemini.

Uteshii samuch lachashecha hetzitu bo et haur, vehaya dolek veholech kol hayyom kullo, shenneemar: "oy lanu ki fana hayyom ki yinnatu tzille arev". vehayeynu deamar rabbi yochanan: ilmale hayiti beoto haddor lo kevativ ella baasiri, mippene sherubbo shel hechol bo nisraf. verabbanan — atchalta defureanuta adifa.
Uvashsheniyya menalan, detanya: megalgelin zechut leyom zakkay, vechova leyom chayyayv.

Amru: keshecharav bet hammikdash barishona, oto hayyom tisha beav haya, umotzae shabbat haya, umotzae sheviit hayta, umishmartah shel yehoyariv hayta. vehalleviyyim hayu omrim shira, veomdin al duchanam. uma shira hayu omrim? "vayyashev alehem et onam uveraatam yatzmitem", velo hispiku lomar "yatzmitem Adonai elohenu", ad shebbau nochrim uchevashum. vechen bashsheniyya.
Nilkeda better — gemara.

Nechersha hair — tanya: keshecharash toranuserufus harasha et hahechol, nigzera gezera al rabban gamliel lahariga. ba oto hegmon veamad bevet hammidrash, veamar: baal hachotem mitbakkesh, baal hachotem mitbakkesh. shama rabban gamliel, azal tesha minnayyhu.

Azal legabbeh betzina amar leh: i matztzelna lach mayytet li lealma deate? amar leh: hen. amar leh: ishteva li. ishteva leh. selek leiggara nafel umit. ugemiri, dechi gazri gezerta umit chad minnayyhu mevatteli ligzertayyhu. yatzta bat kol veamra: oto hegmon mezumman lechayye haolam habba.

Tanu rabbanan: mishshecharav habbayit barishona, nitkabbetzu kittot kittot shel pirche kehunna umaftechot hahechol beyadan, vealu legag hahechol, veamru lefanav: ribbono shel olam! hoil vela zachinu lihyot gizbarin neemanim — yihyu maftechot mesurot lach. uzerakum kelappe mala. veyatzta keen pissat yad vekibbelatan mehem. vehem kaftzu venaflu letoch haur.

Vaalehen konen yeshayahu hannavi: "massa ge chizzayon ma lach efo ki alit kullach laggaggot. teshuot melea ir homiyya kirya alliza chalalayich lo challe cherev velo mete milchama". af behakkadosh baruch hu neemar: "mekarkar kir veshoa el hahar".

Mishshennichnas av memaatin besimcha vechulei. amar rav yehuda bereh derav shemuel bar shilat mishshemeh derav: keshem shemmishshennichnas av memaatin besimcha — kach mishshennichnas adar marbin besimcha.
b: Amar rav pappa: hilkach bar yisrael deit leh dina bahade nochri, lishtemit minneh beav — deria mazzaleh, velaymtze nafsheh baadar — devari mazzaleh.

"Latet lachem acharit vetikva", amar rav yehuda bereh derav shemuel bar shilat mishshemeh derav: ellu dekalim uchele fishtan. "vayyomer ree reach beni kereach sade asher bercho Adonai", amar rav yehuda bereh derav shemuel bar shilat mishshemeh derav: kereach sade shel tappuchim.

Shabbat shechal tisha beav lihyot betochah, asurin lesapper ulechabbes. amar rav nachman: lo shanu ella lechabbes velilbosh, aval lechabbes ulehanniach — muttar. verav sheshet amar: afillu lechabbes ulehanniach asur. amar rav sheshet: teda, devatli katztzare deve rav.
Metiv rav hamenuna: bachamishi muttarim, mippene kevod hashshabbat. lemay? ilema lechabbes velilbosh — may kevod shabbat ikka?

Ella lehanniach. uvachamishi hu dishre, aval hashshabbat kullah — asur! leolam lechabbes velilbosh, uchesheen lo ella chaluk echad. deamar rav assi amar rabbi yochanan: mi sheen lo ella chaluk echad muttar lechabbeso bechullo shel moed. ittemar name, amar rabbi binyamin amar rabbi elazar: lo shanu ella lechabbes velilbosh, aval lehanniach — muttar.
Metivi: asur lechabbes lifne tisha beav, afillu lehanniach leachar tisha beav. vegihutz shellanu, kechibbus shellahen. uchele fishtan en bahem mishshum gihutz. teyuveta.
Shelach rav yitzchak bar giyyore mishshemeh derabbi yochanan: af al pi sheamru kele fishtan en bahem mishshum gihutz, aval asur lelovshan beshabbat shechal tisha beav lihyot betochah.

Amar rav: lo shanu ella lefanav, aval leacharav — muttar. ushemuel amar: afillu leacharav name asur. metivi: shabbat shechal tisha beav lihyot betochah — asur lesapper ulechabbes, uvachamishi — muttarin mippene kevod hashshabbat. ketzad? chal lihyot beechad beshabbat — muttar lechabbes kol hashshabbat kullah.

Bashsheni bashshelishi barvii uvachamishi, lefanav — asur, leacharav — muttar. chal lihyot beerev shabbat — muttar lechabbes bachamishi mippene kevod hashshabbat. veim lo kibbes bachamishi beshabbat — muttar lechabbes beerev shabbat min hammincha ulemala. layet ala abbaye veittema rav acha bar yaakov, aha.
Chal lihyot besheni uvachamishi — korin shelosha umaftir echad. bashshelishi uvarvii — kore echad umaftir echad. rabbi yose omer: leolam korin shelosha umaftir echad. teyuveta dishmuel!

Amar lecha shemuel: tannae hi. detanya: tisha beav shechal lihyot beshabbat, vechen erev tisha beav shechal lihyot beshabbat — ochel veshote kol tzarko, umaale al shulechano afillu kisudat shelomo bishato. veasur lesapper ulechabbes merosh chodesh vead hattaanit, divre rabbi meir. rabbi yehuda omer: kol hachodesh kullo asur. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: eno asur ella otah shabbat bilvad.
Vetanya iddach: venoheg evel merosh chodesh vead hattaanit, divre rabbi meir. rabbi yehuda omer: kol hachodesh kullo asur, rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: eno asur ella otah shabbat bilvad.
Amar rabbi yochanan: usheloshtan mikra echad darshu, dichtiv: "vehishbatti kol mesosah chaggah chodshah veshabbattah". man deamar merosh chodesh vead hattaanit —

a: Mechagga". uman deamar kullo asur — mechodshah", uman deamar kol hashshabbat kullah asur — mishshabbattah".

Amar rava: halacha kerabban shimon ben gamliel. veamar rava: halacha kerabbi meir. vetarvayyhu lekulla, utzericha. dei ashmoinan halacha kerabbi meir, hava amena: afillu merosh chodesh, kamashma lan halacha kerabban shimon ben gamliel.
Vei ashmoinan halacha kerabban shimon ben gamliel, hava amena: afillu leacharav, kamashma lan halacha kerabbi meir.

Erev tisha beav lo yochal adam shene tavshilin kulei. amar rav yehuda: lo shanu ella mishshesh shaot ulemala, aval mishshesh shaot ulematta — muttar. veamar rav yehuda: lo shanu ella bisuda hammafsik bah, aval bisuda sheeno mafsik bah — muttar.

Vetarvayyhu lekulla, utzericha. dei ashmeinan bisuda hammafsik bah, hava amena: afillu mishshesh shaot ulematta — kamashma lan mishshesh shaot ulemala. vei ashmeinan mishshesh shaot ulemala, hava amena: afillu bisuda sheeno mafsik bah — kamashma lan bisuda hammafsik bah.

Tanya kelishshana kamma. tanya kelishshana batra. tanya kelishshana batra: hassoed erev tisha beav, im atid lisod seuda acheret — muttar leechol basar velishtot yayin, veim lav — asur leechol basar velishtot yayin.

Tanya kelishshana kamma: erev tisha beav lo yochal adam shene tavshilin, lo yochal basar velo yishte yayin. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: yeshanne. amar rabbi yehuda: ketzad meshanne? im haya ragil leechol shene tavshilin — yochal min echad, veim haya ragil lisod baasara bene adam — soed bachamishsha, haya ragil lishtot asara kosot — shote chamishsha kosot. bamme devarim amurim mishshesh shaot ulemala, aval mishshesh shaot ulematta — muttar.

Tanya iddach: erev tisha beav lo yochal adam shene tavshilin, lo yochal basar velo yishte yayin, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim: yeshanne. umemaet babbasar uvayyayin. ketzad memaet? im haya ragil leechol litra basar — yochal chatzi litra, haya ragil lishtot log yayin — yishte chatzi log yayin, veim eno ragil kol ikkar — asur. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: im haya ragil leechol tzenon o maliach achar seuddato — harshut beyado.

Tanya iddach: kol shehu mishshum tisha beav — asur leechol basar veasur lishtot yayin veasur lirchotz. kol sheeno mishshum tisha beav — muttar leechol basar velishtot yayin veasur lirchotz. rabbi yishmael berabbi yose omer mishshum aviv: kol shaa shemmuttar leechol basar — muttar lirchotz.

Tanu rabbanan: kol mitzvot hannohagot beavel — nohagot betisha beav; asur baachila uvishtiyya, uvesicha, uvinilat hassandal, uvetashmish hammitta. veasur likrot battora banneviim uvakketuvim, velishnot bammishna battalmud uvammidrash uvahalachot uvaaggadot.

Aval kore hu bimkom sheeno ragil likrot, veshone bimkom sheeno ragil lishnot, vekore bekinot beiyyov, uvidvarim haraim shebbeyirmeya. vetinokot shel bet rabban betelin, mishshum shenneemar: "pikkude Adonai yesharim mesammeche lev".

Rabbi yehuda omer: af eno kore bimkom sheeno ragil likrot, veeno shone bimkom sheeno ragil lishnot. aval kore hu beiyyov uvekinot uvidvarim haraim shebbeyirmeyahu. vetinokot shel bet rabban betelim bo, mishshum shenneemar: "pikkude Adonai yesharim mesammeche lev".
Lo yochal basar velo yishte yayin. tana: aval ochel hu basar maliach veshote yayin miggitto. basar maliach ad kamma? amar rav chinnana bar kahana mishshemeh dishmuel: kol zeman shehu kishlamim.
Veyayin miggitto ad kamma? kol zeman shehu toses. tana: yayin toses en bo mishshum gilluy, vechamma tesisato — shelosha yamim.
Amar rav yehuda amar rav: kach haya minhago shel rabbi yehuda berabbi ilay: erev tisha beav meviin lo pat chareva bemelach, veyoshev
b: Ben tannur lechirayim veochel, veshote aleha kiton shel mayim, vedome kemi shemmeto muttal lefanav.

Tenan hatam: makom shennahagu laasot melacha betisha beav — osin, makom shennahagu shello laasot — en osin. uvechol makom, talmide chachamim betelim. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: leolam yaase kol adam atzmo ketalmid chacham. tanya name hachi, rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: leolam yaase adam atzmo ketalmid chacham, kede sheyyitanne.

Tanya iddach, rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: kol haochel veshote betisha beav — keillu ochel veshote beyom hakkippurim. rabbi akiva omer: kol haose melacha betisha beav — eno roe siman beracha leolam.

Vachachamim omrim: kol haose melacha betisha beav veeno mitabbel al yerushalayim — eno roe besimchatah, shenneemar: "simchu et yerushalaym vegilu vah kol ohaveha sisu ittah masos kol hammitabbelim aleha", mikkan amru: kol hammitabbel al yerushalayim — zoche veroe besimchatah, vesheeno mitabbel al yerushalayim — eno roe besimchatah. tanya name hachi: kol haochel basar veshote yayin betisha beav — alav hakkatuv omer: "vattehi avonotam al atzmotam".
Rabbi yehuda mechayyev bichfiyyayt hammitta, velo hodu lo chachamim. tanya, amru lo lerabbi yehuda: lidvarecha, ubbarot umenikot ma tehe alehen? amar lahem: af ani lo amarti ella beyachol.
Tanya name hachi: mode rabbi yehuda lachachamim besheeno yachol, umodim chachamim lerabbi yehuda beyachol. may benayyhu? ikka benayyhu shear mittot.
Kidtanya: kesheamru lichpot hammitta, lo mittato bilvad hu kofe, ella kol hammittot kullan hu kofe. amar rava: hilcheta ketanna didan, velo hodu lo chachamim kol ikkar.

Amar rabban shimon ben gamliel: lo hayu yamim tovim leyisrael kachamishsha asar beav ucheyom hakkippurim. bishlama yom hakkippurim — mishshum deit beh selicha umechila, yom shennittenu bo luchot haacharonot.
Ella chamishsha asar beav may hi? amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: yom shehutteru shevatim lavo ze baze.
May derush? "ze haddavar asher tzivva Adonai livnot tzelofchad vegomer" — davar ze lo yehe noheg ella bedor ze.

Amar rav yosef amar rav nachman: yom shehuttar shevet binyamin lavo bakkahal, shenneemar: "veish yisrael nishba bammitzpa lemor ish mimmennu lo yitten bitto levinyamin leishsha". may derush? amar rav: "mimmennu", velo mibbanenu.

Amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan: yom shekkalu bo mete midbar. deamar mar: ad shello kalu mete midbar lo haya dibbur im moshe, shenneemar: "vayhi kaasher tammu kol anshe hammilchama lamut. vaydabber Adonai elay". elay haya haddibbur.
Ulla amar: yom shebbittel hoshea ben ela perosdayot shehoshiv yarovam ben nevat al hadderachim shello yaalu yisrael laregel, veamar:

a: Leeze sheyyirtzu yaalu.

Rav matna amar: yom shennittenu haruge vetter likvura. veamar rav matna: oto yom shennittenu haruge vetter likvura, tiknu beyavne "hattov vehammetiv", "hattov"  — shello hisrichu, "vehammetiv" — shennittenu likvura.

Rabba verav yosef deamri tarvayyhu: yom sheppasku millichrot etzim lammaaracha. detanya, rabbi eliezer haggadol omer: mechamishsha asar beav veelach tashash kochah shel chamma, velo hayu kortin etzim lammaaracha, lefi sheenan yeveshin.
Amar rav menashsheya: vekaru leh yom tevar maggal. mikkan veelach, demosef — yosef, udela mosef — yeasef. may "yeasef"? amar rav yosef: tikbereh immeh.

Shebbahen benot yerushalayim kulei. tanu rabbanan: bat melech shoelet mibbat kohen gadol, bat kohen gadol  —mibbat segan, uvat segan — mibbat meshuach milchama, uvat meshuach milchama — mibbat kohen hedyot, vechol yisrael shoalin ze mizze kede shello (yitbayyesh) [levayyesh] et mi sheen lo.
Kol hakkelim teunin tevila. amar rabbi elazar: afillu mekuppalin umunnachin bekufesa.
Benot yisrael yotzot vecholot bakkeramim. tana: mi sheen lo ishsha, nifne lesham.

Meyuchasot shebbahen hayu omrot: bachur vechulei. tanu rabbanan: yefefiyyot shebbahen ma hayu omrot — tenu enechem layyofi, sheen haishsha ella leyofi. meyuchasot shebbahen ma hayu omrot — tenu enechem lammishpacha, lefi sheen haishsha ella levanim. mechoarot shebbahem ma hayu omrot — kechu mikkachachem leshum shamayim, uvilvad shetteatterunu bizhuvim.

Amar ulla biraa, amar rabbi elazar: atid hakkadosh baruch hu laasot machol letzaddikim, vehu yoshev benehem began eden, vechol echad veechad mare beetzbao, shenneemar: "veamar bayyom hahu hinne elohenu ze kivvinu lo veyoshienu ze Adonai kivvinu lo nagila venismecha bishuato".
Hadaran alach bishlosha perakim uselika la massechet taanit

Megilla nikret beachad asar, bishnem asar, bishlosha asar, bearbaa asar, bachamishsha asar. lo pachot, velo yoter. kerakkin hammukkafin choma mimot yehoshua bin nun — korin bachamishsha asar, kefarim vaayayrot gedolot — korin bearbaa asar, ella shehakkefarim makdimin leyom hakkenisa.

Ketzad: chal lihyot arbaa asar bashsheni — kefarim vaayayrot gedolot korin bo vayyom, umukkafot choma lemachar. chal lihyot bashshelishi o barvii — kefarim makdimin leyom hakkenisa, vaayayrot gedolot korin bo vayyom, umukkafot choma lemachar.

Chal lihyot bachamishi — kefarim vaayayrot gedolot korin bo vayyom, umukkafot choma lemachar. chal lihyot erev shabbat — kefarim makdimin leyom hakkenisa, vaayayrot gedolot umukkafot choma korin bo vayyom.

Chal lihyot bashshabbat — kefarim vaayayrot gedolot makdimin vekorin leyom hakkenisa, umukkafot choma lemachar. chal lihyot achar hashshabbat — kefarim makdimin leyom hakkenisa, vaayayrot gedolot korin bo vayyom, umukkafot choma lemachar.

Gemara megilla nikret beachad asar. menalan? menalan?! kidvaenan lememar lekamman: chachamim hekellu al hakkefarim lihyot makdimin leyom hakkenisa, kede sheyyesappeku mayim umazon laachehem shebbakkerakkim.

Anan hachi kaamrinan: mikkedi kullehu anshe keneset haggedola takkeninhu, dei salka datach anshe keneset haggedola arbaa asar vachamishsha asar takkun — atu rabbanan veakri takkanta detakkinu anshe keneset haggedola? vehatnan: en bet din yachol levattel divre bet din chavero ella im ken gadol mimmennu bechachma uveminyan.
Ella peshita kullehu anshe keneset haggedola takkinu. hecha remiza?
Amar rav shemen bar abba amar rabbi yochanan, amar kera: "lekayyem et yeme happurim haelle bizmannehem", zemannim harebe tikkenu lahem.
Hay mibbaya leh legufeh! im ken lema kera "zeman", may "zemannehem" — zemannim tuva.
Veakkatti mibbee leh: zemanno shel ze lo kizmanno shel ze! im ken, lema kera "zemannam", may "zemannehem" — shamat minna kullehu.
Ema zemannim tuva! "zemannehem" dumeya dizmannam": ma "zemannam" tere — af "zemannehem" tere.
Veema teresar utelesar? kidamar rav shemuel bar yitzchak: shelosha asar zeman kehilla lakkol hi, vela tzerich lerabboye, hacha name: shelosha asar zeman kehilla lakkol hi, vela tzerich lerabboye.
Veema shittesar veshivsar! "velo yaavor" ketiv.
Verabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar, amar kera: "kayyamim asher nachu vahem hayyehudim". "yamim", "kayyamim" — lerabbot achad asar ushenem asar.
Veema teresar utelesar! amar rav shemuel bar yitzchak: shelosha asar zeman kehilla lakkol hi, vela tzerich lerabboye. veema shittesar veshivsar! "velo yaavor" ketiv.
Rabbi shemuel bar nachmani may tama la amar mibbizmannehem"? "zeman" "zemannam" "zemannehem" la mashma leh.
Verav shemen bar abba may tama la amar mikkayyamim"? amar lach: hahu ledorot hu dichtiv.
Amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan: zo divre rabbi akiva setimtaa, dedaresh "zeman" "zemannam" "zemannehem", aval chachamim omrim: en korin otah ella bizmannah.
Metivi, amar rabbi yehuda: ematay — bizman shehashshanim ketiknan veyisrael sheruyin al admatan, aval bizman hazze, hoil umistakkelin bah — en korin otah ella bizmannah.
Rabbi yehuda allibba deman? ilema allibba derabbi akiva — afillu bizman hazze ita lehay takkanta!
Ella lav, allibba derabbanan, uvizman shehashshanim ketiknan veyisrael sheruyin al admatan — miha karenan, teyuveta derabbi yochanan teyuveta.
Ikka deamri: amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan: zo divre rabbi akiva setimtaa, aval chachamim amru: bizman hazze, hoil umistakkelin bah — en korin otah ella bizmannah.
Tanya name hachi, amar rabbi yehuda: ematay — bizman shehashshanim ketiknan veyisrael sheruyin al admatan, aval bizman hazze, hoil umistakkelin bah — en korin otah ella bizmannah.
Rav ashe kashya leh derabbi yehuda adderabbi yehuda,
b: Umokem la levarayyta kerabbi yose bar yehuda.

Umi amar rabbi yehuda "bizman hazze, hoil umistakkelin bah — en korin otah ella bizmannah"? ureminhi, amar rabbi yehuda: ematay — makom shennichnasin bashsheni uvachamishi. aval makom sheen nichnasin bashsheni uvachamishi — en korin otah ella bizmannah.
Mekom shennichnasin bashsheni uvachamishi miha karenan, vaafillu bizman hazze! umokem la levarayyta kerabbi yose bar yehuda.
Umishshum dekashya leh derabbi yehuda adderabbi yehuda mokem lah levarayyta kerabbi yose bar yehuda?!

Rav ashe shemia leh deikka detane la kerabbi yehuda veikka detane la kerabbi yose bar yehuda, umiddekashya leh derabbi yehuda adderabbi yehuda, amar: man detane la kerabbi yehuda — lav davvka, man detane la kerabbi yose bar yehuda — davvka.

Kerakkim hammukkafim choma mimot yehoshua bin nun korin bachamishsha asar vechulei. menahane mille? amar rava, deamar kera: "al ken hayyehudim happerazim hayyoshvim beare happerazot vegomer". middifrazim bearbaa asar — mukkafin bachamishsha asar.
Veema: perazim bearbaa asar, mukkafin kelal kelal la! velav yisrael ninhu? veod: "mehoddu vead kush" ketiv.
Veema: perazim bearbesar mukkafin bearbesar uvachamesar, kedichtiv: "lihyot osim et yom arbaa asar lechodesh adar veet yom chamishsha asar [bo] bechol shana"!
I hava ketiv "et yom arbaa asar vachamishsha asar" — kidkaamrat, hasheta dichtiv "et yom arbaa asar veet yom chamishsha asar" — ata "et" ufasek: hane bearbaa asar, vehane bachamishsha asar.
Veema: perazim — bearbesar, mukkafin — i bau bearbesar, i bau bachamesar! amar kera "bizmannehem", zemanno shel ze lo zemanno shel ze.
Veema bitlesar! keshushan.
Ashkechan asiyyay, zechira menalan? amar kera: "vehayyamim haelle nizkarim venaasim", ittakkash zechira laasiyyay.
Matnitin dela ki hay tanna. detanya, rabbi yehoshua ben korcha omer: kerakkin hammukkafin choma mimot achashverosh korin bachamishsha asar.
May tama derabbi yehoshua ben korcha? ki shushan. ma shushan mukkefet choma mimot achashverosh vekorin bachamishsha asar — af kol shemmukkefet choma mimot achashverosh korin bachamishsha asar.

Vetanna didan, may tama? yalef "perazi" "perazi". ketiv hacha: "al ken hayyehudim happerazim", uchetiv hatam: "levad meare happerazi harebe meod". ma lehallan mukkefet choma mimot yehoshua bin nun, af kan mukkefet choma mimot yehoshua bin nun.
Bishlama rabbi yehoshua ben korcha la amar ketanna didan — delet leh "perazi" "perazi", ella tanna didan may tama la amar kerabbi yehoshua ben korcha?
May tama?! deha it leh "perazi" "perazi"! hachi kaamar: ella shushan, deavda keman? la kifrazim vela kemukkafin!
Amar rava, veamri la kedi: shane shushan — hoil venaasa bah nes.
Bishlama letanna didan, hayeynu dichtiv: "medina umedina veir vair". "medina umedina" — lechallek ben mukkafin choma mimot yehoshua bin nun lemukkefet choma mimot achashverosh.
"Ir veir" name, lechallek ben shushan lishar ayayrot. ella lerabbi yehoshua ben korcha, bishlama "medina umedina" — lechallek ben shushan lishar ayayrot, ella "ir veir" lemay ata?

Amar lecha rabbi yehoshua ben korcha: uletanna didan mi nicha? kevan deit leh "perazi" "perazi" — "medina umedina" lema li? ella kera lidrasha hu daata, vechidrabbi yehoshua ben levi hu daata. deamar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: kerach, vechol hassamuch lo, vechol hannire immo — niddon kichrach.
Ad kamma? amar rabbi yirmeya veittema rabbi chiyyay bar abba: kemechammatan litverya — mil. velema mil! ha ka mashma lan: deshiura demil kamma have — kemechammatan litverya.
Veamar rabbi yirmeya veittema rabbi chiyyay bar abba: mantzefach — tzofim amarum.
Vetisbera? vehachtiv: "elle hammitzvot", sheen navi rashshay lechaddesh davar meatta? veod, haamar rav chisda: mem vesamech shebballuchot

a: Benes hayu omdin!
In, mihva havo, vela havo yadi he beemtza teva vehe besof teva, vaato tzofim vetakkinu petuchin beemtza teva usetumin besof teva.
Sof sof "elle hammitzvot", sheen navi atid lechaddesh davar meatta! ella shechachum vechazru veyissedum.

Veamar rabbi yirmeya veittema rabbi chiyyay bar abba: targum shel tora — uneklos hagger amaro mippi rabbi eliezer verabbi yehoshua. targum shel neviim — yonatan ben uzziel amaro mippi chaggay zecharya umalachi, venizdazea eretz yisrael arba meot parsa al arba meot parsa. yatzta bat kol veamra: mi hu ze sheggilla setarayy livne adam?

Amad yonatan ben uzziel al raglav veamar: ani hu sheggilliti setarecha livne adam, galuy veyadua lefanecha shello lichvodi asiti, velo lichvod bet abba, ella lichvodcha asiti, shello yirbu machalokot beyisrael.
Veod bikkesh legallot targum shel ketuvim, yatzta bat kol veamra lo: dayyekka! may tama — mishshum deit beh ketz mashiach.

Vetargum shel tora, uneklos hagger amaro? veha amar rav ika bar avin amar rav chananel amar rav: may dichtiv: "vayyikreu besefer torat haelohim meforash vesom sechel vayyavinu bammikra". "vayyikreu besefer torat haelohim" — ze mikra; "meforash" — ze targum;
"Vesom sechel" — ellu happesukin; "vayyavinu bammikra" — ellu piske teamim, veamri la — ellu hammasorot! — shechachum vechazru veyissedum.

May shena deorayyta dela izdazea veaddinvie izdazea? deorayyta — mipparsha milleta, dinvie — ikka mille demipparshan veikka mille dimsatteman, dichtiv: "bayyom hahu yigdal hammisped birushalam kemispad hadadrimmon bevikat megiddon",

Veamar rav yosef: ilmale targuma dehay kera — la yadana may kaamar: beyoma hahu yisge mispeda birushelem kemispeda deachav bar amri diktal yateh hadadrimmon ben tavrimmon beramot gilad uchemispeda deyoshiyya bar amon diktal yateh paro chagira bevikat megiddo.

"Veraiti ani daniyyel levaddi et hammara vehaanashim asher hayu immi lo rau et hammara aval charada gedola nafla alehem vayyivrechu behechave". man ninhu anashim? amar rabbi yirmeya veittema rabbi chiyyay bar abba: ze chaggay zecharya umalachi.
Inhu adifi minneh, veihu adif minnayyhu. inhu adifi minneh — deinhu nevie veihu lav navi. ihu adif minnayyhu — deihu chaza veinhu la chazo.
Vechi meachar dela chazo, may tama ibbeitu? af al gav deinhu la chazo, mazzalayyhu chazo.

Amar ravina: shema minna: hay man demibbeit, af al gav deihu la chaze, mazzaleh chaze. may takkanteh? likre keriat shema. vei kaem bimkom hattinnofet — linshof midducheteh arba garmide. vei la — lema hachi: "izza deve tabbache shammina minnay".

Vehasheta deamrat "medina umedina veir vair" — lidrasha, "mishpacha umishpacha" lemay ata? amar rabbi yose bar chanina: lehavi mishpechot kehunna uleviyya, shemmevattelin avodatan uvain lishmoa mikra megilla.
Deamar rav yehuda amar rav: kohanim baavodatan uleviyyim beduchanan veyisrael bemaamadan — kullan mevattelin avodatan uvain lishmoa mikra megilla.

Tanya name hachi: kohanim baavodatan, uleviyyim beduchanan, veyisrael bemaamadan — kullan mevattelin avodatan uvain lishmoa mikra megilla. mikkan samchu shel bet rabbi shemmevattelin talmud tora uvain lishmoa mikra megilla, kal vachomer meavoda: uma avoda shehi chamura — mevattelinan, talmud tora lo kol shekken.
Vaavoda chamura mittalmud tora? vehachtiv: "vayhi bihyot yehoshua biricho vayyissa enav vayyar vehinne ish omed lenegdo [vegomer] vayyishtachu (leappav)".
Vehechi aved hachi? vehaamar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: asur leadam sheyyitten shalom lachavero ballayla, chayyshinan shemma shed hu! shane hatam deamar leh: "ki ani sar tzeva Adonai".
Vedilma meshakkeri? gemiri dela mappeki shem shamayim levattala.

Amar lo: emesh bittaltem tamid shel ben haarbayim, veachshav bittaltem talmud tora. amar lo: al eze mehen bata? amar lo: "atta vati", miyyad: "vayyalen yehoshua ballayla hahu betoch haemek", amar rabbi yochanan:
b: Melammed shellan beumekah shel halacha. veamar rav shemuel bar uneya: gadol talmud tora yoter mehakeravat temidin, shenneemar: "atta vati"!
La kashya: ha derabbim, veha deyachid.

Udeyachid kal? vehatnan: nashim bammoed meannot aval lo metappechot, rabbi yishmael omer: im hayu semuchot lammitta — metappechot. berashe chodashim bachanukka uvefurim, meannot umetappechot baze uvaze, aval lo mekonnot.
Veamar rabba bar huna: en moed bifne talmid chacham — kol shekken chanukka ufurim.
Kevod tora kaamrat. kevod tora deyachid — chamur, talmud tora deyachid — kal.
Amar rava, peshita li: avoda umikra megilla — mikra megilla adif, midderabbi yose bar chanina. talmud tora umikra megilla — mikra megilla adif, middesamchu shel bet rabbi.
Talmud tora umet mitzva — met mitzva adif, middetanya: mevattelin talmud tora lehotzaat met, ulehachnasat kalla. avoda umet mitzva — met mitzva adif, miuleachoto".
Detanya: "uleachoto" ma talmud lomar? hare shehaya holech lishchot et pischo velamul et beno, veshama shemmet lo met, yachol yittamma —
Amarta: "lo yittamma". yachol keshem sheeno mittamme laachoto, kach eno mittamme lemet mitzva — talmud lomar: "uleachoto". laachoto hu deeno mittamme, aval mittamme lemet mitzva.

Bae rava: mikra megilla umet mitzva he minnayyhu adif? mikra megilla adif mishshum parsome nissa, o dilma met mitzva adif mishshum kevod habberiyyot? batar devaya hadar pashta: met mitzva adif, deamar mar: gadol kevod habberiyyot sheddoche et lo taase shebbattora.
Gufa, amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: kerach, vechol hassamuch lo, vechol hannire immo — niddon kichrach. tana: samuch — af al pi sheeno nire, nire — af al pi sheeno samuch.
Bishlama nire af al pi sheeno samuch, mashkachat la kegon deyatva berosh hahar. ella samuch af al pi sheeno nire hechi mashkachat la? amar rabbi yirmeya: sheyyoshevet bannachal.

Veamar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: kerach sheyyashav ulevassof hukkaf — niddon kichfar. may tama? dichtiv: "veish ki yimkor bet moshav ir choma", shehukkaf ulevassof yashav, velo sheyyashav ulevassof hukkaf.

Veamar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: kerach sheen bo asara batlanin — niddon kichfar. may ka mashma lan? tenena: ezo hi ir gedola — kol sheyyesh bah asara batlanin. pachot mikkan, hare ze kefar? kerach itzterich leh, af al gav demikkali leh mealma.

Veamar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: kerach shecharav ulevassof yashav niddon kichrach. may charav? illema charvu chomotav: yashav — in, lo yashav — la? veha tanya, rabbi eliezer bar yose omer: "asher lo choma", af al pi sheen lo achshav vehaya lo kodem lachen.
Ella may "charav" — shecharav measara batlanin.
Veamar rabbi yehoshua ben levi:

a: Lod veono vege hacharashim — mukkafot choma mimot yehoshua bin nun havo.

Vehane yehoshua benanhi? veha elpaal benanhi, dichtiv: "[u]vene elpaal ever umisham vashamer hu bana et ono veet lod uvenoteha"! uletamaych, asa benanhi, dichtiv: "vayyiven (asa et are habbetzurot asher lihuda)".
Amar rabbi elazar: hane mukkafot choma mimot yehoshua bin nun havo. charuv bime pilegesh begiva, vaata elpaal benanhi. hadur inneful, ata asa shappetzinhu.
Dayka name, dichtiv: "vayyomer lihuda nivne et hearim haelle", mikkelal dearim havo meikkara. shema minna.
Veamar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: nashim chayyayvot bemikra megilla, sheaf hen hayu beoto hannes. veamar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: purim shechal lihyot beshabbat, shoalin vedorshin beinyano shel yom.
May irya purim? afillu yom tov name! detanya: moshe tikken lahem leyisrael sheyyehu shoalin vedorshin beinyano shel yom: hilchot pesach bappesach, hilchot atzeret baatzeret, vehilchot chag bechag!
Purim itztericha leh, mahu detema: nigzor mishshum derabba, ka mashma lan.
Veamar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: chayyayv adam likrot et hammegilla ballayla velishnotah bayyom, shenneemar: "elohay ekra yomam velo taane velayla velo dumiyya li".
Sevur minna lemikreyay belelya ulemitne matnitin dida bimama. amar lehu rabbi yirmeya: ledidi mipparsha li minneh derabbi chiyyay bar abba, kegon deamri inashe: eevor parashta da veetneyay.
Ittemar name, amar rabbi chelbo amar ulla biraa: chayyayv adam likrot et hammegilla ballayla velishnotah bayyom, shenneemar: "lemaan yezammercha chavod velo yiddom Adonai elohay leolam odekka".
Ella shehakkefarim makdimin leyom hakkenisa. amar rabbi chanina: chachamim hekellu al hakkefarim lihyot makdimin leyom hakkenisa kede sheyyesappeku mayim umazon laachehem shebbakkerakkin.
b: Lememra detakkanta dichrakkin have? vehatnan: chal lihyot bashsheni — kefarim vaayayrot gedolot korin bo vayyom. veim ita, laykdemu leyom hakkenisa! havu lehu asara, vaasara la takkinu rabbanan.
Ta shema: chal lihyot bachamishi — kefarim vaayayrot gedolot korin bo vayyom, veim ita, laykdemu leyom hakkenisa deachad asar hu! miyyom hakkenisa leyom hakkenisa la dachenan.

Ta shema, amar rabbi yehuda: ematay — bimkom shennichnasim bashsheni uvachamishi, aval mekom sheen nichnasim bashsheni uvachamishi — en korin otah ella bizmannah. vei salka datach takkanta dichrakkin hi — mishshum deen nichnasim bashsheni uvachamishi mafsedi lehu lichrakkin?
La tema kede sheyyesappeku mayim umazon, ella ema: mippene shemmesappekim mayim umazon laachehem shebbakkerakkin.
Ketzad? chal lihyot bashsheni bashshabbat — kefarim vaayayrot gedolot korin bo vayyom vechulei. may shena resha denaket siddura deyarcha, umay shena sefa denaket siddura deyome?
Ayyeyde demithafchi leh naket siddura deyome.
Chal lihyot beerev shabbat vechulei. matnitin manni? i rabbi, i rabbi yose.

May rabbi? detanya: chal lihyot beerev shabbat — kefarim vaayayrot gedolot makdimin leyom hakkenisa, umukkafin choma korin bo vayyom. rabbi omer, omer ani: lo yiddachu ayayrot mimmekoman, ella ellu vaellu korin bo vayyom.
May tama detanna kamma? dichtiv: "bechol shana veshana". ma kol shana veshana ayayrot kodmot lammukkafin, af kan ayayrot kodmot lammukkafin.
Veema: "bechol shana veshana", ma kol shana veshana en nidchin ayayrot mimmekoman — af kan lo yiddachu ayayrot mimmekoman! shane hacha dela efshar.
Verabbi, may tameh? "bechol shana veshana", ma kol shana veshana en ayayrot nidchin mimmekoman — af kan lo yiddachu ayayrot mimmekoman.
Veema: "bechol shana veshana", ma kol shana veshana ayayrot kodmot lammukkafin — af kan name ayayrot kodmot lammukkafin! shane hacha dela efshar.

May rabbi yose? detanya: chal lihyot beerev shabbat — mukkafin uchefarim makdimin leyom hakkenisa, vaayayrot gedolot korin bo vayyom. rabbi yose omer: en mukkafin kodmin laayayrot, ella ellu vaellu korin bo vayyom.

May tama detanna kamma? dichtiv: "bechol shana veshana", ma kol shana veshana ayayrot bearbaa asar, uzemanno shel ze lo zemanno shel ze — af kan ayayrot bearbaa asar, uzemanno shel ze lo zemanno shel ze.
Veema: "bechol shana veshana", ma kol shana veshana en mukkafin kodmin laayayrot, af kan en mukkafin kodmin laayayrot! shane hacha dela efshar.
May tameh derabbi yose? "bechol shana veshana", ma kol shana veshana en mukkafin kodmin laayayrot — af kan en mukkafin kodmin laayayrot.
Veema: "bechol shana veshana", ma kol shana veshana zemanno shel ze lo zemanno shel ze — af kan zemanno shel ze lo zemanno shel ze! shane hacha dela efshar.

Vesavar rabbi ayayrot la dachinan leyom hakkenisa? vehatanya: chal lihyot beshabbat — kefarim makdimin leyom hakkenisa, vaayayrot gedolot korin baerev shabbat, umukkafot choma lemachar. rabbi omer, omer ani: hoil venidchu ayayrot mimmekoman — yiddachu leyom hakkenisa.
Hachi hasheta? hatam zemannam shabbat hi, vehoil denidchu — yiddachu. vehacha, zemannam erev shabbat!

Keman azla ha deamar rabbi chelbo amar rav huna: purim shechal lihyot beshabbat — hakkol nidchin leyom hakkenisa. hakkol nidchin salka datach?! veha ikka mukkafin deavdi limchar! ella: kol hannidche yiddache leyom hakkenisa. keman — kerabbi.

Dechulle alma miha megilla beshabbat la karinan. may tama? amar rabba: hakkol chayyayvin bikriat megilla (uvitkiat shofar), veen hakkol bekiin bemikra megilla. gezera shemma yittelenna beyado veyelech etzel baki lilmod, veyaavirenna arba ammot birshut harabbim.
Vehayeynu tama deshofar. vehayeynu tama delulav.
Rav yosef amar: mippene sheenehen shel aniyyim nesuot bemikra megilla. tanya name hachi: af al pi sheamru kefarim makdimin leyom hakkenisa — govin bo vayyom, umechallekin bo vayyom.

Af al pi sheamru? adderabba, mishshum deamru hu! ella: hoil veamru shekkefarim makdimin leyom hakkenisa — govin bo vayyom, umechallekin bo vayyom, mippene sheenehem shel aniyyim nesuot bemikra megilla. aval

a: Simcha, enah noheget ella bizmannah.
Amar rav: megilla bizmannah — korin otah afillu beyachid, shello bizmannah — baasara. rav assi amar: ben bizmannah ben shello bizmannah — baasara. hava ovada, vechash leh rav leha derav assi.

Umi amar rav hachi? vehaamar rav yehuda bereh derav shemuel bar shilat mishshemeh derav: purim shechal lihyot beshabbat — erev shabbat zemannam. erev shabbat zemannam?! veha shabbat zemannam hu! ella lav hachi kaamar: shello bizmannam kizmannam. ma zemannam — afillu beyachid, af shello bizmannam — afillu beyachid?

La, leinyan mikra megilla baasara. ella may "erev shabbat zemannam" — leappoke midderabbi, deamar: hoil venidchu ayayrot mimmekoman — yiddachu leyom hakkenisa, ha ka mashma lan deerev shabbat zemannam hu.
Mishna i zo hi ir gedola — kol sheyyesh bah asara batlanin. pachot mikkan — hare ze kefar.
Beellu amru makdimin velo meacharin. aval zeman atze kohanim, vetisha beav, chagiga, vehakehel — meacharin velo makdimin.
