Af al pi sheamru makdimin velo meacharin — muttarin behesped uvetaanit, umattanot laevyonim. amar rabbi yehuda: ematay? mekom shennichnasin besheni uvachamishi. aval mekom sheen nichnasin lo bashsheni velo bachamishi — en korin otah ella bizmannah.
Gemara tana: asara batlanin shebbevet hakkeneset.
Beellu, amru makdimin velo meacharin. may tama? amar rabbi abba amar shemuel: amar kera "velo yaavor".
Veamar rabbi abba amar shemuel: minnayin sheen monin yamim lashshanim — shenneemar: "lechodshe hashshana" — chodashim atta mone lashshanim, vei atta mone yamim lashshanim.

Verabbanan dekesari mishshum rabbi abba amru: minnayin sheen mechashshevin shaot lechodashim, shenneemar: "ad chodesh yamim". yamim atta mechashshev lechodashim, vei atta mechashshev shaot lechodashim.
Aval zeman atze chohanim vetisha beav vachagiga vehakehel — meacharin velo makdimin. tisha beav — akdome pureanut la makdemi. chagiga vehakehel — mishshum deakkatti la meta zeman chiyyuvayyhu.
Tana: chagiga vechol zeman chagiga meacharin. bishlama chagiga, dei mikkela beshabbeta meacharinan la levatar shabbeta. ella zeman chagiga may hi?
Amar rav oshaya, hachi kaamar: chagiga beshabbat, veolat reiyyay afillu beyom tov, dizman chagiga — meacharin.
Manni — bet shammay hi, ditnan, [bet shammay omrim]: meviin shelamim beyom tov, veen somchin alehen,
Aval lo olot. uvet hillel omrim: meviin shelamim veolot vesomchin alehen.

Rava amar: chagiga, kol zeman chagiga — meacharin, tefe — la. ditnan: mi shello chag beyom tov harishon shel chag — chogeg veholech et kol haregel kullo, veyom tov haacharon shel chag. avar haregel velo chag — eno chayyayv beachrayuto.
Rav ashe amar: chagiga vechol zeman chagiga — meacharin, vaafillu atzeret dechad yoma — meacharin, ditnan: modim sheim chal atzeret lihyot beshabbat — sheyyom tevoach achar hashshabbat.
Amar rabbi elazar amar rabbi chanina: rabbi nata netia befurim,
b: Verachatz bikronah shel tzippori beshiva asar betammuz, uvikkesh laakor tisha beav — velo hodu lo.

Amar lefanav rabbi abba bar zavda: rabbi, lo kach haya maase. ella tisha beav shechal lihyot beshabbat hava, udechinuhu leachar hashshabbat. veamar rabbi: hoil venidcha — yiddache, velo hodu chachamim. kare aleh: "tovim hashshenayim min haechad".

Verabbi hechi nata netia befurim? vehatane rav yosef: "simcha umishte veyom tov", "simcha" — melammed sheasurim behesped, "mishte" — melammed sheasur betaanit, "veyom tov" — melammed sheasur baasiyyayt melacha! ella: rabbi, bar arbesar hava, vechi neta — bachamesar neta.
Ini? veha rabbi bitverya hava, uteverya mukkefet choma mimot yehoshua bin nun havay! ella, rabbi bar chamesar hava, vechi neta — bearbesar hava.

Umi peshita leh ditverya mukkefet choma mimot yehoshua bin nun? veha chizkiyya kare bitverya bearbesar uvachamesar? mesappeka leh i mukkefet choma mimot yehoshua bin nun hi i la. lechizkiyya mesappeka leh, lerabbi peshita leh.
Vechi peshita leh, mi shere? vehachtiv bimgillat taanit: et yom arbaa asar veet yom chamishsha asar yome purayya innun, dela lemispad behon,
Veamar rava: lo nitzrecha, ella leesor et shel ze baze veet shel ze baze? hane mille behesped uvetaanit, aval melacha — yom echad vetu la.
Ini? veha rav chazyeh lehahu gavra dahava ka shade kittana befurayya, velatyeh vela tzemach kittaneh! hatam, bar yoma hava.
Rabba bereh derava amar: afillu tema beyomeh — hesped vetaanit kabbilu alayyhu, melacha la kabbilu alayyhu.
Demeikkara ketiv: "simcha umishte veyom tov", ulevassof ketiv: "laasot otam yeme mishte vesimcha", veillu "yom tov" la ketiv.
Veella rav may tama latyeh lehahu gavra? devarim hammuttarin vaacherim nahagu bahen issur hava. uveatreh derabbi la nehug.
Veibbaet ema: leolam nehug — verabbi netia shel simcha nata. keditnan: avru ellu velo naanu — memaatin bemassa umattan, bevinyan uvintia, beerusin uvenissuin.
Vetana ala: binyan — binyan shel simcha, netia — netia shel simcha. ezehu binyan shel simcha? ze habbone bet chatnut livno. ezo hi netia shel simcha? ze hannotea avvaranke shel melachim.

Gufa: chizkiyya kare bitverya bearbesar uvachamesar, mesappeka leh i mukkefet choma mimot yehoshua bin nun hi i la. umi mesappeka leh milleta ditverya? vehachtiv: "veare mivtzar hatztziddim tzer vechammat rakkat vechinnaret", vekayyma lan rakkat zo teverya! hayeynu tama dimsappeka leh, mishshum dechad gisa shura deyamma havat.
I hachi, ammay mesappeka leh? vadday lav choma hi! detanya: "asher lo choma" — velo shur iggar. "saviv" — perat litverya sheyyammah chomatah.

Leinyan batte are choma la mesappeka leh. ki ka mesappeka leh leinyan mikra megilla, may perazim umay mukkafin dichtivi gabbe mikra megilla? mishshum dehane miggallu vehane la miggallu — veha name miggalleya, o dilma: mishshum dehane miggenu vehane la miggenu — veha name migganya. mishshum hachi mesappeka leh.

Rav assi kare megilla behutzal bearbesar uvachamesar. mesappeka leh i mukkefet choma mimot yehoshua bin nun hi, i la. ikka deamar, amar rav assi: hay hutzal devet binyamin, mukkefet choma mimot yehoshua hi.
Amar rabbi yochanan: ki havena talya amena milleta dishelna lesavayyay

a: Veishtechach kevoti. chammat zo teverya, velamma nikra shemah chammat? al shum chamme teverya. rakkat zo tzippori, velamma nikra shemah rakkat? mishshum demiddalyay kerakta denahra. kinneret zo ginnosar, velamma nikra shemah kinneret? dimtiki pera kekala dechinnare.

Amar rava: mi ikka leman deamar rakkat lav teverya hi? veha ki shachev inish hacha, hatam safdi leh hachi: "gadol hu besheshach, veshem lo berakkat". vechi masseki arona lehatam, safdi leh hachi: ohave seridim yoshve rakkat, tzeu vekabbelu haruge omek.
Ki nach nafsheh derabbi zera, petach aleh hahu safdana: eretz shinar hara veyalda, eretz tzevi giddela shaashueha. oy na lah, amra rakkat, ki ibbeda keli chemdatah.

Ella amar (rabba): chammat zo chamme gerar, rakkat zo teverya, kinneret zo ginnosar. velamma nikra shemah rakkat? sheafillu rekanin shebbah melein mitzvot kerimmon. rabbi yirmeya amar: rakkat shemah, velamma nikra shemah teverya? sheyyoshevet betabburah shel eretz yisrael. (rava) amar: rakkat shemah, velamma nikra shemah teverya? shettova reiyyaytah.
Amar zeera: kitron zo tzippori. velamma nikra shemah tzippori? sheyyoshevet berosh hahar ketzippor.

Vekitron, tzippori hi? veha kitron bechelko shel zevulun havay, dichtiv: "zevulun lo horish et yoshve kitron veet yoshve nahalol", uzevulun mitraem al middotav hava, shenneemar: "zevulun am cheref nafsho lamut", ma taam? mishshum denaftali al merome sade".

Amar zevulun lifne hakkadosh baruch hu: ribbono shel olam, leachayy natatta lahem sadot ucheramim, veli natatta harim vegivot! leachayy natatta lahem aratzot, veli natatta yammim uneharot! amar lo: kullan tzerichin lach al yede chillazon, shenneemar: "[ammim har yikrau] usefune temune chol".

Tane rav yosef: "sefune" — ze chillazon, "temune" — zo tarit, "chol" — zo zechuchit levana. amar lefanav: ribbono shel olam mi modieni? amar lo: "sham yizbechu zivche tzedek", siman ze yehe lecha: kol hannotel mimmecha belo damim — eno moil bifrakmatya shello kelum.

Vei salka datach kitron zo tzippori, ammay mitraem al middotav? veha havya tzippori milleta daadifa tuva! vechi tema delet ba zavat chalav udevash, vehaamar resh lakish: ledidi chaze li zavat chalav udevash detzippori, vehavya shishsha asar mil al shishsha asar mil!

Vechi tema dela nefisha dideh kedaachu, vehaamar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan: ledidi chaze li zavat chalav udevash dechol ara deyisrael, vehavya kemibbe chubbe ad akra detulebakne, esrin vetarten parse ureka, ufuteya shitta parse!
Afillu hachi, sadot ucheramim adifa leh. dayka name, dichtiv: "venaftali al merome sade". shema minna.

Amar rabbi avahu: "veekron teaker" — zo kesari bat edom, shehi yoshevet ben hacholot, vehi hayta yated tekua leyisrael bime yevonim. uchesheggavra malchut bet chashmonay venitztzechum, hayu korin otah "achidat migdal shir".

Amar rabbi yose bar chanina, may dichtiv: "vahasiroti damav mippiv veshikkutzav mibben shinnav venishar gam hu lelohenu". "vahasiroti damav mippiv" — ze bet bamayya shellahen. "veshikkutzav mibben shinnav" — ze bet galya shellahen.

"Venishar gam hu lelohenu" — ellu batte chenesiyyot uvatte midrashot shebbeedom. "vehaya kealluf bihuda veekron kivusi" — ellu teratrayot vekirkesayot shebbeedom, sheatidin sare yehuda lelammed bahen tora barabbim.
Amar rabbi yitzchak: leshem zo pamyays, "ekron teaker" — zo kesari bat edom, shehi hayta metroppolin shel melachim. ikka deamri: dimrabbi bah malche, veikka deamri: demokmi minna malche.

Kesari virushalayim, im yomar lecha adam: charvu shetehen — al taamen. yashvu shetehen — al taamen. charva kesari veyashva yerushalayim, charva yerushalayim veyashva kesari — taamen, shenneemar: "immala hochorava". im melea zo — chareva zo, im melea zo — chareva zo.
Rav nachman bar yitzchak amar mehacha: "uleom milom yeematz".

Veamar rabbi yitzchak, may dichtiv: "yuchan rasha bal lamad tzedek". amar yitzchak lifne hakkadosh baruch hu: ribbono shel olam, yuchan esav. amar lo: rasha hu! amar lo: "bal lamad tzedek". amar lo: "beeretz nechochot yeavvel". amar lo: im ken, "bal yire geut Adonai".

Veamar rabbi yitzchak, may dichtiv: "al titten Adonai maavayye rasha zemamo al tafek yarumu sela" — amar yaakov lifne hakkadosh baruch hu: ribbono shel olam, al titten leesav harasha taavat libbo. "zemamo al tafek" — zo
b: Germamya shel edom, sheilmale hen yotzin, macharivin kol haolam kullo.

Veamar rabbi chama bar chanina: telat mea ketire taga ikka begermamya shel edom, utelat mea veshittin vechamsha marzebane ikka beromi, uvechol yoma nafki hane leappe hane umikketil chad minnayyhu, umittardi leokome malka.
Veamar rabbi yitzchak, im yomar lecha adam: yagati velo matzati — al taamen. lo yagati umatzati — al taamen. yagati umatzati — taamen.
Hane mille bedivre tora, aval bemassa umattan — siyyayta hu min shemayya. uledivre tora la amaran ella lechaddode, aval leokome girsa — siyyayta min shemayya hi.

Veamar rabbi yitzchak: im raita rasha shehashshaa mesacheket lo — al titgare bo, shenneemar: "al titchar bammereim". velo od, ella shedderachav matzlichin, shenneemar: "yachilu derachav bechol et". velo od, ella shezzoche baddin, shenneemar: "marom mishpatecha minnegdo". velo od, ella sheroe besonav, shenneemar: "kol tzorrav yafiach bahem".

Ini? vehaamar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi shimon ben yochay: muttar lehitgarot barshaim baolam hazze, shenneemar: "ozve tora yehallu rasha veshomre tora yitgaru vam", vetanya, rabbi dostay bar matun amar: muttar lehitgarot barshaim baolam hazze, veim lechashcha adam lomar "al titchar bammereim veal tekanne beose avla" — mi shellibbo nokfo omer ken.
Ella: "al titchar bammereim" — lihyot kammereim, "veal tekanne beose avla" — lihyot keose avla. veomer: "al yekanne libbecha bachattaim vegomer!
La kashya: ha bemille dideh, ha bemille dishmayya.

Veibbaet ema: ha veha bemille dideh. vela kashya: ha betzaddik gamur, ha betzaddik sheeno gamur. deamar rav huna, may dichtiv: "lamma tabbit bogdim tacharish bevalla rasha tzaddik mimmennu", tzaddik mimmennu — bolea, tzaddik gamur — eno bolea.
Vei baet ema: shaa mesacheket lo shane.

Amar ulla: italya shel yavan, ze kerach gadol shel romi. vehavya telat mea parsa al telat mea parsa. veyesh bah shelosh meot shishshim vachamishsha shevokim, keminyan yemot hachamma. vekatan shebbechullam shel mochre ofot, vehavya shishsha asar mil al shishsha asar mil. umelech soed bechol yom beechad mehen.

Vehaddar bah, af al pi sheeno nolad bah — notel peras mibbet hammelech. vehannolad bah, af al pi sheeno dar bah — notel peras mibbet hammelech. usheloshet alafim be vane yesh bo, vachamesh meot challonot maalin ashan chutz lachoma. tziddo echad yam vetziddo echad harim ugevaot, tziddo echad mechitza shel barzel vetziddo echad cholsit umetzula.
Mishna karu et hammegilla baadar harishon venitabbera hashshana — korin otah baadar sheni. en ben adar harishon laadar hashsheni ella keriat hammegilla umattanot laevyonim.
Gemara ha leinyan seder parashiyyot, ze vaze shavin.

Manni matnitin? la tanna kamma, vela rabbi eliezer berabbi yose, vela rabban shimon ben gamliel. detanya: karu et hammegilla baadar harishon venitabbera hashshana — korin otah baadar hashsheni, shekkol mitzvot shennohagot bashsheni nohagot barishon, chutz mimmikra megilla.
Rabbi eliezer berabbi yose omer: en korin otah baadar hashsheni, shekkol mitzvot shennohagot bashsheni nohagot barishon.
Rabban shimon ben gamliel omer mishshum rabbi yose: af korin otah baadar hashsheni, shekkol mitzvot shennohagot bashsheni en nohagot barishon. veshavin behesped uvetaanit sheasurin baze uvaze.

Rabban shimon ben gamliel hayeynu tanna kamma? amar rav pappa: seder parashiyyot ikka benayyhu, detanna kamma savar lechattechilla bashsheni, vei avud barishon — avud. bar mimmikra megilla, deaf al gav dekaru barishon — karu bashsheni.
Verabbi eliezer berabbi yose savar: afillu mikra megilla lechattechilla barishon. verabban shimon ben gamliel savar: afillu seder parashiyyot, i karu barishon karu bashsheni.
Manni? i tanna kamma — kashya mattanot, i rabbi eliezer berabbi yose — kashya name mikra megilla, i rabban shimon ben gamliel — kashya seder parashiyyot!
Leolam tanna kamma, utena mikra megilla vehu haddin mattanot laevyonim, deha beha talya.

Veibbaet ema: leolam rabban shimon ben gamliel hi, umatnitin chassore michassera vehachi katane: en ben arbaa asar shebbaadar harishon learbaa asar shebbaadar hashsheni ella mikra megilla umattanot. ha leinyan hesped vetaanit — ze vaze shavin, veillu seder parashiyyot la mayyre.
Amar rabbi chiyyay bar avin amar rabbi yochanan: hilcheta kerabban shimon ben gamliel sheamar mishshum rabbi yose.

Amar rabbi yochanan, ushenehem mikra echad darshu: "bechol shana veshana", rabbi eliezer berabbi yose savar: "bechol shana veshana", ma kol shana veshana — adar hassamuch lishvat, af kan — adar hassamuch lishvat.
Verabban shimon ben gamliel savar: "bechol shana veshana", ma kol shana veshana — adar hassamuch lenisan, af kan — adar hassamuch lenisan.
Bishlama rabbi eliezer berabbi yose mistabber tama, deen maavirin al hammitzvot. ella rabban shimon ben gamliel may tama?
Amar rabbi tavi: tama derabbi shimon ben gamliel, mismach geulla ligulla adif.
Rabbi elazar amar: tama derabban shimon ben gamliel mehacha, dichtiv: "lekayyem et iggeret happurim hazzot hashshenit".
Veitzterich lemichtav

a: "Hashshenit" veitzterich lemichtav "bechol shana veshana". dei mibbechol shana veshana" hava amena ki kusheyan, ka mashma lan "hashshenit". vei ashmoinan "hashshenit" hava amena battechilla barishon uvashsheni, ka mashma lan "bechol shana veshana".
Verabbi eliezer berabbi yose hay "hashshenit" may aved leh? mibbee leh lechidrav shemuel bar yehuda, deamar rav shemuel bar yehuda: battechilla kevauha beshushan, ulevassof bechol haolam kullo.

Amar rav shemuel bar yehuda: shalcha lahem ester lachachamim: kivuni ledorot! shalchu lah: kina at meoreret alenu leven haummot. shalcha lahem: kevar ketuva ani al divre hayyamim lemalche maday ufaras.

Rav verav chanina verabbi yochanan verav chaviva matnu. bechulleh seder moed kol ki hay zuga challofe rabbi yochanan umeayyel rabbi yonatan. shalcha lahem ester lachachamim: kitvuni ledorot. shalchu lah: "halo chatavti lecha shalishim", shilleshim velo ribbeim,
Ad shemmatzu lo mikra katuv battora: "ketov zot zikkaron bassefer". "ketov zot" — ma shekkatuv kan uvemishne tora. "zikkaron" — ma shekkatuv banneviim, "bassefer" — ma shekkatuv bammegilla.

Ketannae: "ketov zot" — ma shekkatuv kan, "zikkaron" — ma shekkatuv bemishne tora, "bassefer" — ma shekkatuv banneviim. divre rabbi yehoshua. rabbi elazar hammodai omer: "ketov zot" — ma shekkatuv kan uvemishne tora, "zikkaron" — ma shekkatuv banneviim, "besefer" — ma shekkatuv bimgilla.
Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: ester enah metammea et hayyadayim.
Lememra desavar shemuel ester lav beruach hakkodesh neemra? vehaamar shemuel: ester beruach hakkodesh neemra! neemra likrot, velo neemra lichtov.

Metivi, rabbi meir omer: kohelet eno metamme et hayyadayim, umachloket beshir hashshirim. rabbi yose omer: shir hashshirim metamme et hayyadayim, umachloket bekohelet. rabbi shimon omer: kohelet mikkulle bet shammay umechumere bet hillel, aval rut veshir hashshirim veester metammein et hayyadayim! hu deamar kerabbi yehoshua.

Tanya, rabbi shimon ben menasya omer: kohelet eno metamme et hayyadayim, mippene shechochmato shel shelomo hi. amru lo: vechi zo bilvad amar? vahalo kevar neemar: "vaydabber sheloshet alafim mashal", veomer: "al tosp al devarav".
May "veomer"? vechi tema: memar tuva amar, dei bae — ikketiv, udei bae — la ikketiv. ta shema: "al tosp al devarav".

Tanya rabbi eliezer omer: ester beruach hakkodesh neemra, shenneemar: "vayyomer haman belibbo". rabbi akiva omer: ester beruach hakkodesh neemra, shenneemar: "vattehi ester noset chen beene kol roeha".

Rabbi meir omer: ester beruach hakkodesh neemra, shenneemar: "vayyivvada haddavar lemordochay". rabbi yose ben dormaskit omer: ester beruach hakkodesh neemra, shenneemar: "uvabbizza lo shalchu et yadam".
Amar shemuel: i havay hatam, hava amena milleta daadifa mikkullehu, shenneemar: "kiyyemu vekibbelu" — kiyyemu lemala ma shekkibbelu lematta.

Amar rava: lechullehu it lehu pircha, levar middishmuel delet leh pircha: derabbi eliezer — sevara hu dela hava inish dachashiv lemalka kevoteh, vehay ki ka mappesh tuva veamar — addateh denafsheh kaamar.
Derabbi akiva — dilma kerabbi elazar, deamar: melammed shekkol echad veechad nidmeta lo keummato.
Veha derabbi meir — dilma kerabbi chiyyay bar abba, deamar: bigtan vateresh shene tarsiyyim hayu.
Veha derabbi yose ben dormaskit — dilma peristake shaddur. dishmuel, vadday let leh pircha. amar ravina: hayeynu deamri inashe: tava chada pilpalta charifta mimmele tzanne kare.
Rav yosef amar mehacha: "vime happurim haelle lo yaavru mittoch hayyehudim". rav nachman bar yitzchak omer mehacha: "vezichram lo yasuf mizzaram".
Umattanot laevyonim. tane rav yosef: "umishloach manot ish lereehu" — shete manot leish echad. "umattanot laevyonim" — shete mattanot lishne bene adam.
Rabbi yehuda nesia shaddar leh lerabbi oshaya atma deigla tilta vegarba dechamra, shelach leh:
b: Kiyyaymta banu rabbenu, "umishloach manot ish lereehu umattanot laevyonim".
Rabba shaddar leh lemare bar mar beyad abbaye mele taska dekashba umele kasa kimcha daavishuna. amar leh abbaye: hasheta amar mari: i chaklaa malka leheve — dikkula mitztzavvereh la nachet.
Hadar shaddar leh ihu mele taska dezangevila umele kasa defilpelata arichata. amar abbaye: hasheta amar mar: ana shaddari leh chuleya, veihu shaddar li churepa.

Amar abbaye: ki nefaki mibbe mar, hava savana. ki metay lehatam, karivu li shittin tzae deshittin mine kedera, vaachali behu shittin peluge. uvishshula batrayyta havo karu leh tzeli kedar, uveay lemikkas tzaa abbatre.
Amar abbaye, hayeynu deamri inashe: kafen anya vela yada. i name: ravvcha livsima shechiach.
Abbaye bar avin verabbi chanina bar avin mechallefi seodtayyhu lahadade.
Amar rava: michayyayv inish levassome befurayya ad dela yada ben arur haman levaruch mardochay.

Rabba verabbi zera avadu seudat purim bahade hadade. ibbassum. kam rabba shachteh lerabbi zera. lemachar, bae rachame veachayeh. leshana, amar leh: nete mar venaaved seudat purim bahade hadade. amar leh: la bechol shata veshata mitrechish nissa.

Amar rava: seudat purim sheachalah ballayla — lo yatza yede chovato. may tama — "yeme mishte vesimcha", ketiv: rav ashe hava yatev kammeh (derav kahana), nega vela ato rabbanan. amar leh: may tama la ato rabbanan? dilma teridi bisudat purim. amar leh: vela hava efshar lemechla beureta? amar leh: la shemia leh lemar ha deamar rava: seudat purim sheachalah ballayla lo yatza yede chovato? amar leh: (amar rava hachi?) [amar leh: in]. tena minneh arbein zimnin vedame leh keman demannach bechiseh.
Mishna en ben yom tov lashshabbat ella ochel nefesh bilvad.
Gemara ha leinyan machshire ochel nefesh — ze vaze shavin.
Matnitin dela kerabbi yehuda, detanya: en ben yom tov lashshabbat ella ochel nefesh, rabbi yehuda mattir af machshire ochel nefesh.
May tama detanna kamma? amar kera: "hu" — velo machshirav, verabbi yehuda (amar): "lachem" — lachem lechol tzorchechem.
Veiddach name, hachtiv "lachem"? lachem velo legoyim, lachem velo lichlavim.
Veiddach name, ha ketiv "hu"? ketiv "hu" uchetiv "lachem". kan bemachshirin sheefshar laasotan meerev yom tov, kan bemachshirin shei efshar laasotan meerev yom tov.
Mishna en ben shabbat leyom hakkippurim, ella shezze — zedono bide adam, veze — zedono becharet.
Gemara ha leinyan tashlumin — ze vaze shavin.

Manni matnitin? rabbi nechuneya ben hakkana hi, detanya: rabbi nechuneya ben hakkana haya ose et yom hakkippurim kashshabbat letashlumin, ma shabbat — mitchayyev benafsho ufatur min hattashlumin, af yom hakkippurim — mitchayyev benafsho ufatur min hattashlumin.

Tenan hatam: kol chayyayve charetot shellaku — nifteru mide keritatan, shenneemar: "venikla achicha leenecha", kevan shellaka — hare hu keachicha. divre rabbi chananya ben gamliel. amar rabbi yochanan: chalukin alav chaverav al rabbi chananya ben gamliel.
Amar rava: amri be rav, tenena: en ben yom hakkippurim lashshabbat ella shezze — zedono bide adam, veze — zedono behikkaret. veim ita — idde veidde bide adam hi!

Amar rav nachman: ha manni — rabbi yitzchak hi, deamar: malkot bechayyayve charetot lekka. detanya, rabbi yitzchak omer: chayyayve charetot bakkelal hayu, velamma yatzat karet baachoto — ledunah becharet velo bemalkot.
Rav ashe amar: afillu tema rabbanan, ze — ikkar zedono bide adam, veze — ikkar zedono behikkaret.

a: Mishna en ben hammuddar hanaa mechavero lammuddar mimmennu maachol, ella derisat haregel vechelim sheen osin bahen ochel nefesh.
Gemara ha leinyan kelim sheosin bahen ochel nefesh — ze vaze shavin.
Derisat haregel? ha la kafdi inashe! amar rava: ha manni — rabbi eliezer, deamar: vittur asur bemuddar hanaa.
Mishna en ben nedarim lindavot, ella shehannedarim chayyayv beachrayutan, unedavot eno chayyayv beachrayutan.
Gemara ha leinyan "bal teacher" — ze vaze shavin.

Tenan hatam: e zehu neder? haomer: "hare alay ola". ezo hi nedava? haomer: "hare zo ola", uma ben nedarim lindavot? nedarim, metu o nignevu o avdu — chayyayv beachrayutan, nedavot, metu o nignevu o avdu — eno chayyayv beachrayutan.
Menahane mille? detanu rabbanan: "venirtza lo lechapper alav", rabbi shimon omer: et shealav — chayyayv beachrayuto, veet sheeno alav — eno chayyayv beachrayuto.
May mashma? amar rabbi yitzchak bar avdimi: kevan deamar "alay" — keman ditin akkatpeh dame.
Mishna en ben zav haroe shete reiyyot laroe shalosh ella korban.
Gemara ha leinyan mishkav umoshav usefirat shiva — ze vaze shavin.
Menahane mille? detanu rabbanan: rabbi simay omer: mana hakkatuv shetayim, ukerao "tame". shalosh, ukerao "tame". ha ketzad? shetayim lattumea veshalosh lakkorban.
Veemar: shetayim letumea velo lekorban, shalosh lekorban velo letumea! amrat: ad shello raa shalosh raa shetayim.

Veemar: shetayim lekorban velo letumea, shalosh af letumea! la salka datach, detanya: "vechipper alav hakkohen lifne Adonai mizzovo", miktzat zavin meviin korban umiktzat zavin en meviin korban. ha ketzad? raa shalosh — mevi, shetayim — eno mevi.
O eno ella: raa shetayim — mevi, raa shalosh — eno mevi, amrat: ad shello raa shalosh raa shetayim.
Veitzterich derabbi simay veitzterich "mizzovo", dei midderabbi simay — hava amena ki kusheyayn, kamashma lan "mizzovo". vei "mizzovo" — la yadana kamma reiyyot, kamashma lan derabbi simay.
Vehasheta deamrat "mizzovo" lidrasha, "vechi yithar hazzav mizzovo" may darshat beh?
Hahu mibbee leh lechidtanya: "vechi yithar hazzav" — lichsheyyifsok mizzovo, ["mizzovo" —] velo mizzovo venigo. "mizzovo vesafar" — limmed al zav baal shete reiyyot shettaun sefirat shiva.
Vahalo din hu, im metamme mishkav umoshav lo yehe taun sefirat shiva?
b: Shomeret yom keneged yom tochiach, shemmetammea mishkav umoshav, veenah teuna sefirat shiva.

Veaf atta al titma al ze, sheaf al pi shemmetamme mishkav umoshav lo yehe taun sefirat shiva, talmud lomar: "mizzovo vesafar", miktzat zovo vesafar — limmed al zav baal shete reiyyot shettaun sefirat shiva.
Amar leh rav pappa leabbaye: may shena hay "mizzovo" dimrabbe beh zav baal shete reiyyot, umay shena hay "mizzovo" dimmaet beh zav baal shete reiyyot?
Amar leh: i salka datach hay lemaote hu daata — lishtok kera minneh, vechi tema: atya middina, shomeret yom keneged yom tochiach.
Vechi tema: hay mibbee leh "mizzovo" velo minnigo, im ken lichtov kera "vechi yithar hazzav" velishtok. "mizzovo" lema li? limmed al zav baal shete reiyyot shettaun sefirat shiva.
Mishna en ben metzora musegar limtzora muchelat ella peria uferima.
En ben tahor mittoch hesger letahor mittoch hechlet ella tiglachat vetzipporim.
Gemara ha leinyan shilluach [vetumea] — ze vaze shavin.
Menahane mille? detane rav shemuel bar yitzchak kammeh derav huna: "vetiharo hakkohen mispachat hi vechibbes begadav vetaher", tahor mipperia uferima demeikkara.
Amar leh rava: ella meatta, gabbe zav dichtiv "vechibbes begadav vetaher", hatam may "vetaher" meikkara ikka?
Ella: tahor hasheta milletamme keli cheres behesset, af al gav dahadar chaze — la metamme lemafrea.
Hacha name tahor [hasheta milletamme bevia lemafrea].
Ella amar rava, mehacha: "vehatztzarua asher bo hannega", mi shetztzarato teluya begufo — yatza ze sheen tzarato teluya begufo ella beyamim.
Amar leh abbaye: ella meatta "kol yeme asher hannega bo yitma", mi shetztzarato teluya begufo — hu detaun shilluach, vesheen tzarato teluya begufo — en taun shilluach,
Vechi tema: hachi name, veha katane: en ben metzora musegar limtzora muchelat ella peria uferima, ha leinyan shilluach uletammoye bevia — ze vaze shavin!
Amar leh: "yeme" "kol yeme" — lerabbot metzora musegar leshilluach.
I hachi, tiglachat vetzipporim may tama la? dekatane: en ben tahor mittoch hesger lattahor mittoch hechlet — ella tiglachat vetzipporim!
Amar abbaye: amar kera: "veyatza hakkohen el michutz lammachane vehinne nirpa nega hatztzaraat", mi shetztzarato teluya birfuot. yatza ze sheen tzarato teluya birfuot ella beyamim.
Mishna en ben sefarim litfillin umezuzot, ella shehassefarim nichtavin bechol lashon, utefillin umezuzot enan nichtavot ella ashshurit.
Rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: af bisfarim lo hittiru sheyyikkatvu ella yevonit.
Gemara ha letofran begidin uletamme et hayyadayim — ze vaze shavin.

Usefarim nichtavin bechol lashon vechulei. ureminhu: mikra shekketavo targum, vetargum shekketavo mikra, uchetav ivri — eno metamme et hayyadayim ad sheyyichtevennu bichtav ashshurit, al hassefer, uvidyo.
Amar rava: la kashya

a: Kan begofan shellanu, kan begofan shellahen.

Amar leh abbaye: bemay okemta lehahi? begofan shellahen, may irya mikra shekketavo targum vetargum shekketavo mikra? afillu mikra shekketavo mikra vetargum shekketavo targum name. deha katane: ad sheyyichtevennu ashshurit al hassefer bidyo!
Ella, la kashya: ha rabbanan, ha rabban shimon ben gamliel.
I rabban shimon ben gamliel ha ikka yevanit! ella, la kashya: kan bisfarim, kan bitfillin umezuzot.
Tefillin umezuzot may tama? mishshum dichtiv behu: "vehayu" — bahavayaytan yehu, may targum shekketavo mikra ikka? bishlama tora — ikka "yegar sahaduta", ella hacha may targum ikka?
Ella, la kashya: kan bimgilla, kan bisfarim. megilla may tama, dichtiv ba: "kichtavam vechilshonam". may targum shekketavo mikra ikka?
Amar rav pappa: "venishma pitgam hammelech". rav nachman bar yitzchak amar: "vechol hannashim yittenu yekar levalehen".
Rav ashe amar: ki tanya hahi bishar sefarim, verabbi yehuda hi. detanya: tefillin umezuzot en nichtavin ella ashshurit, verabbotenu hittiru yevanit.
Vehachtiv "vehayu"! ella ema: sefarim nichtavim bechol lashon, verabbotenu hittiru yevanit. hittiru?! mikkelal detanna kamma asar!
Ella ema: rabbotenu lo hittiru sheyyikkatvu ella yevanit. vetanya amar rabbi yehuda: af keshehittiru rabbotenu yevanit — lo hittiru ella besefer tora,

Umishshum maase detalmay hammelech. detanya: maase betalmay hammelech shekkinnes shivim ushenayim zekenim vehichnisan beshivim ushenayim battim velo gilla lahem al ma kinsan. venichnas etzel kol echad veechad, veamar lahem: kitvu li torat moshe rabbechem. natan hakkadosh baruch hu belev kol echad veechad etza vehiskimu kullan ledaat achat.
Vechatvu lo: "elohim bara bereshit". "eese adam betzelem uvidmut".
"Vaychal beyom hashshishshi vayyishbot beyom hashshevii". "zachar unekeva berao", velo katvu "beraam".
"Hava erda veavla sham sefatam". "vattitzchak sara bikroveha".
"Ki veappam hargu shor uvirtzonam ikkeru evus". "vayyikkach moshe et ishto veet banav vayyarkivem al nose bene adam".
"Umoshav bene yisrael asher yashvu bemitzrayim uvishar aratzot arba meot shana". "vayyishlach et zaatute bene yisrael". "veel zaatute bene yisrael lo shalach yado".
b: "Lo chemed echad mehem nasati". "asher chalak Adonai elohecha otam lehair lechol haammim".
"Vayyelech vayyaavod elohim acherim asher lo tzivviti leovdam".
Vechatvu lo: "et tzeirat haraglayim", velo katvu lo "et haarnevet", mippene sheishto shel talmay arnevet shemah, shello yomar sachaku bi hayyehudim vehetilu shem ishti battora.

Rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: af bassefarim lo hittiru sheyyikkatvu ella yevanit. amar rabbi avahu amar rabbi yochanan: halacha kerabban shimon ben gamliel. veamar rabbi yochanan: may tama derabban shimon ben gamliel, amar kera: "yaft elohim leyefet veyishkon beohole shem", devarav shel yefet yihyu beohole shem.
Veema gomer umagog? amar rabbi chiyyay bar abba: hayeynu tama, dichtiv: "yaft elohim leyefet", yafyuto shel yefet yehe beohole shem.
Mishna en ben kohen mashuach beshemen hammishcha limrubbe vegadim ella par habba al kol hammitzvot.
En ben kohen meshammesh lechohen sheavar ella par yom hakkippurim vaasirit haefa.
Gemara ha leinyan par yom kippurim vaasirit haefa — ze vaze shavin.
Matnitin dela kerabbi meir, dei rabbi meir, [ha tanya]: merubbe vegadim mevi par habba al kol hammitzvot, divre rabbi meir, vachachamim omrim: eno mevi.
May tameh derabbi meir — detanya: "mashiach", en li ella mashuach beshemen hammishcha, merubbe vegadim minnayin? talmud lomar: "hammashiach".

Bemay okemna — dela kerabbi meir. ema sefa: en ben kohen meshammesh lechohen sheavar ella par yom hakkippurim vaasirit haefa. ha lechol divrehen — ze vaze shavin, atan lerabbi meir, detanya: era bo pesul uminnu kohen acher tachtav, rishon — chozer laavodato, sheni — kol mitzvot kehunna gedola alav, divre rabbi meir. rabbi yose omer: rishon — chozer laavodato, sheni — eno rauy lo lechohen gadol velo lechohen hedyot.

Veamar rabbi yose: maase berabbi yosef ben illem mitztzippori sheera bo pesul bechohen gadol uminnuhu tachtav, uva maase lifne chachamim, veamru: rishon — chozer laavodato, sheni — eno rauy lo lechohen gadol velo lechohen hedyot.
Kohen gadol — mishshum eva, kohen hedyot — mishshum maalin bakkodesh velo moridin. resha rabbanan, vesefa rabbi meir!
Amar rav chisda, in: resha rabbanan vesefa rabbi meir. rav yosef amar: rabbi hi, venasev la allibba detannae.
Mishna en ben bama gedola labbama ketanna ella pesachim. ze hakkelal: kol shehu niddar veniddav — karev bevama, vechol sheeno lo niddar velo niddav — eno karev bevama.
Gemara pesachim vetu la? ema keen pesachim.
Manni — rabbi shimon hi. detanya, rabbi shimon omer: af tzibbur lo hikrivu ella pesachim vechovot shekkavua lahem zeman, aval chovot sheen kavua lahem zeman — hacha vehacha la keruv.
Mishna en ben shilo lirushalayim, ella shebbeshilo ochlin kadashim kallim umaaser sheni bechol haroe, uvirushalayim lifnim min hachoma.
Vechan vechan, kodshe kodashim neechalin lifnim min hakkelaim. kedushshat shilo —

a: Yesh achareha hetter, ukedushshat yerushalayim — en achareha hetter.
Gemara amar rabbi yitzchak: shamati shemmakrivin bevet chonyo bizman hazze. kasavar: bet chonyo lav bet avoda zara hi, veka savar: kedushsha rishona — kiddesha lishatah velo kiddesha leatid lavo.

Dichtiv: "ki lo batem ad atta el hammenucha veel hannachala". "menucha" — zo shilo, "nachala" — zo yerushalayim, makkish nachala limnucha: ma "menucha" yesh achareha hetter, af "nachala" yesh achareha hetter.
Amaru leh: amarta? amar lehu: la. amar rava: haelohim! amra, ugemirna la minneh.

Umay tama ka hadar beh? mishshum kushya derav mari. demotev rav mari: kedushshat shilo — yesh achareha hetter. kedushshat yerushalayim — en achareha hetter. veod tenan: mishshebbau lirushalayim neesru habbamot, velo haya lahem od hetter, vehi hayta nachala.
Tannae hi. (detanya) amar rabbi eliezer: shamati keshehayu bonin bahechol, osin kelaim lahechol ukelaim laazara. ella shebbahechol bonin mibbachutz, uvaazara bonin mibbifnim.

Veamar rabbi yehoshua: shamati shemmakrivin af al pi sheen bayit, ochlin kodshe kadashim af al pi sheen kelaim, kadashim kallim umaaser sheni af al pi sheen choma, mippene shekkedushsha rishona kiddesha lishatah vekiddesha leatid lavo. mikkelal derabbi eliezer savar lo kiddesha leatid lavo.

Amar leh ravina lerav ashe: mimmay? dilma dechulle alma kedushsha rishona kiddesha lishatah vekiddesha leatid lavo, umar — may dishmia leh kaamar, umar — may dishmia leh kaamar. vechi tema: kelaim lerabbi eliezer lema li? litzniuta bealma.

Ella ki hane tannae, detanya: amar rabbi yishmael berabbi yose: lamma manu chachamim et ellu? shekkeshealu bene haggola matzu et ellu vekiddeshum, aval harishonot batlu mishshebbatla haaretz. alma kasavar: kedushsha rishona kiddesha lishatah velo kiddesha leatid lavo.

Ureminhu, amar rabbi yishmael berabbi yose: vechi ellu bilvad hayu? vahalo kevar neemar: "shishshim ir kol chevel argov", uchetiv: "kol elle arim betzurot choma gevoha". ella lamma manu chachamim et ellu? shekkeshealu bene haggola matzu ellu vekiddeshum.
Kiddeshum?!
b: Hasheta [ha] amri la tzericha lekaddoshe! ella: matzu et ellu umenaum.

Velo ellu bilvad, ella kol shettaale lecha masoret beyadcha meavotecha shemmukkefet choma mimot yehoshua bin nun — kol hammitzvot hallalu nohagin bah, mippene shekkedushsha rishona kiddesha lishatah vekiddesha leatid lavo. kashya derabbi yishmael adderabbi yishmael.

Tere tannae allibba derabbi yishmael berabbi yose. veibbaet ema, ha rabbi elazar bar yose amra, detanya: rabbi elazar berabbi yose amar: "asher lo choma", af al pi sheen lo achshav vehaya lo kodem lachen.
"Vayhi bime achashverosh", amar rabbi levi veittema rabbi yonatan: davar ze masoret beyadenu meanshe keneset haggedola, kol makom shenneemar "vayhi" eno ella leshon tzaar.
"Vayhi bime achashverosh" — hava haman. "vayhi bime shefot hashshoftim" — hava raav. "vayhi ki hechel haadam larov" — "vayyar Adonai ki rabba raat haadam".

"Vayhi benosam mikkedem" — "hava nivne lanu ir". "vayhi bime amrafel" — "asu milchama". "vayhi bihyot yehoshua biricho" — "vecharbo shelufa beyado". "vayhi Adonai et yehoshua" — "vayyimalu bene yisrael". "vayhi ish echad min haramatayim" — "ki et channa ahev vaAdonai sagar rachmah".

"Vayhi (ki) zaken shemuel" — "velo halchu vanav bidrachav". "vayhi david lechol derachav maskil [vaAdonai immo]" — "vayhi shaul oyen et david". "vayhi ki yashav hammelech beveto" — "rak atta lo tivne habbayit".

Vehachtiv: "vayhi bayyom hashshemini", vetanya: oto hayyom hayta simcha lifne hakkadosh baruch hu keyom shennivreu bo shamayim vaaretz, ketiv hacha: "vayhi beyom hashshemini", uchetiv hatam: "vayhi (voker) yom echad"!
Ha shechev nadav vaavihu.
Vehachtiv: "vayhi vishmonim shana vearba meot shana"! vehachtiv: "vayhi kaasher raa yaakov et rachel"! vehachtiv "vayhi erev vayhi voker yom echad"! vehaikka sheni! vehaikka shelishi! vehaikka tuva!
Amar rav ashe: kol "vayhi" — ikka hachi veikka hachi, "vayhi bime" — eno ella leshon tzaar.
Chamsha "vayhi bime" havu: "vayhi bime achashverosh", "vayhi bime shefot hashshoftim", "vayhi bime amrafel", "vayhi bime achaz", "vayhi bime yehoyakim".
Veamar rabbi levi, davar ze masoret beyadenu meavotenu: amotz vaamatzya — ache havu. may ka mashma lan?

Ki ha deamar rabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar rabbi yonatan: kol kalla shehi tzenua bevet chamiha — zocha veyotzin mimmenna melachim uneviim. menalan? mittamar, dichtiv: "vayyireha yehuda vayyachsheveha lezona ki chisseta paneha", mishshum dechisseta paneha "vayyachsheveha lezona"?

Ella mishshum dechisseta paneha bevet chamiha, vela hava yada la, zachta veyatzu mimmenna melachim uneviim. melachim — middavid, neviim — deamar rabbi levi, masoret beyadenu meavotenu: amotz vaamatzya achim hayu, uchetiv: "chazon yeshayahu ven amotz".
Veamar rabbi levi, davar ze masoret beyadenu meavotenu: mekom aron eno min hammidda.

Tanya name hachi: aron sheasa moshe yesh lo eser ammot lechol ruach, uchetiv: "velifne haddevir esrim amma orech", uchetiv: "kenaf hakkeruv haechad eser ammot uchenaf hakkeruv haechad eser ammot", aron gufeh hecha hava kae? ella lav shema minna: benes haya omed.

Rabbi yonatan patach la pitcha lehay parashta mehacha: "vekamti alehem vegomer vehichratti levavel shem ushear venin vaneched neum Adonai". "shem" — ze hakketav, "shear" — ze leshon, "nin" — ze malchut, "vaneched" — zo vashti.
Rabbi shemuel bar nachmani, patach la pitcha lehay parashta mehacha: "tachat hannaatzutz yaale verosh vetachat hassirpad yaale hadas".
"Tachat hannaatzutz" — tachat haman harasha sheasa atzmo avoda zara, dichtiv: "uvechol hannaatzutzim uvechol hannahalolim".
"Yaale berosh" — ze mardochay shennikra rosh lechol habbesamim, shenneemar: "veatta kach lecha besamim rosh mor deror", umetargeminan: "mor deche".
"Tachat hassirpad" — tachat vashti harshaa bat beno shel nevuchadnetztzar harasha shessaraf refidat bet Adonai, dichtiv: "refidato zahav".
"Yaale hadas" — zo ester hatztzaddeket shennikret hadassa, shenneemar: "vayhi omen et hadassa". "vehaya laAdonai leshem" — zo mikra megilla. "leot olam lo yikkaret" — ellu yeme furim.
Rabbi yehoshua ben levi patach la pitcha lehay parashta mehacha: "vehaya kaasher sas Adonai alechem lehetiv etchem ken yasis... lehara etchem".

Umi chade hakkadosh baruch hu bemappaltan shel reshaim? veha ketiv: "betzet lifne hechalutz veomrim hodu laAdonai ki leolam chasdo", veamar rabbi yochanan: mippene ma lo neemar "ki tov" behodaa zo? lefi sheen hakkadosh baruch hu sameach bemappaltan shel reshaim.
Veamar rabbi yochanan, may dichtiv: "velo karav ze el ze kol hallayla" — bikkeshu malache hashsharet lomar shira, amar hakkadosh baruch hu: maase yaday tovin bayyam, veattem omrim shira?
Amar rabbi elazar: hu eno sas, aval acherim mesis. vedayka name, dichtiv: "ken yasis", vela ketiv "yasus". shema minna.

Rabbi abba bar kahana patach la pitcha lehay parashta mehacha: "leadam shettov lefanav natan chochma vedaat vesimcha" — ze mardochay hatztzaddik, "velachote natan inyan leesof velichnos" — ze haman, "latet letov lifne haelohim" — ze mardechay veester, dichtiv: "vattasem ester et mordochay al bet haman".
Rabba bar ofran patach la pitcha lehay parashta mehacha: "vesamti chisi beelam vehaavadti mishsham melech vesarim". "melech" — zo vashti, "vesarim" — ze haman vaaseret banav.
Rav dimi bar yitzchak patach la pitcha lehay parashta mehacha,

a: "Ki avadim anachnu uveavdutenu lo azavanu elohenu vayyat alenu chesed lifne malche faras", ematay — bizman haman.

Rabbi chanina bar pappa patach la pitcha leha parashta mehacha: "hirkavta enosh leroshenu banu vaesh uvammayim", "baesh" — bime nevuchadnetztzar harasha. "uvammayim" — bime faro, "vattotzienu larvaya" — bime haman.

Rabbi yochanan patach le pitcha leha parashta mehacha: "zachar chasdo veemunato levet yisrael rau chol afse aretz et yeshuat elohenu", ematay "rau chol afse aretz et yeshuat elohenu" — bime mordochay veester.

Resh lakish patach la pitcha leha parashta mehacha: "ari nohem vedov shokek moshel rasha al am dal", "ari nohem" — ze nevuchadnetztzar harasha, dichtiv beh: "ala arye missubbecho". "dov shokek" — ze achashverosh, dichtiv beh: "vaaru cheva ochori tinyayna damya ledov", vetane rav yosef: ellu parsiyyim, sheochlin veshotin kedov, umesurebalin basar kedov, umegaddelin sear kedov, veen lahem menucha kedov.
"Moshel rasha" — ze haman. "al am dal" — ellu yisrael, shehem dallim min hammitzvot.

Rabbi elazar patach le pitcha leha parashta mehacha: "baatzaltayim yimmach hammekare uveshiflut yadayim yidlof habbayit", bishvil atzlut shehaya lahem leyisrael shello asku battora, naasa sono shel hakkadosh baruch hu mach. veen "mach" ella ani, shenneemar: "veim mach hu meerkecha", veen "mekare" ella hakkadosh baruch hu, shenneemar: "hamekare vammayim aliyyotav".
Rav nachman bar yitzchak patach la pitcha leha parashta mehacha: "shir hammaalot lule Adonai shehaya lanu yomar na yisrael. lule Adonai shehaya lanu bekum alenu adam". "adam" — velo melech.

Rava patach la pitcha leha parashta mehacha: "birvot tzaddikim yismach haam uvimshol rasha yeanach am", "birvot tzaddikim yismach haam" — ze mordochay veester, dichtiv: "vehair shushan tzahala vesamecha". "uvimshol rasha yeanach am" — ze haman, dichtiv: "vehair shushan navocha".
Rav matna amar mehacha: "ki mi goy gadol asher lo elohim kerovim elav". rav ashe amar mehacha: "o hanissa elohim vegomer".
"Vayhi bime achashverosh", amar rav: vayy vehe, hada dichtiv: "vehitmakkartem sham leoyvecha laavadim velishfachot vegomer".

Ushemuel amar: "lo meastim velo gealtim lechallotam". "lo meastim" — bime yevonim. "velo gealtim" — bime nevuchadnetztzar. "lechallotam" — bime haman. "lehafer beriti ittam" — bime farsiyyim. "ki ani Adonai elohehem" — bime gog umagog.

Bematnita tana: "lo meastim" — bime kasdim, sheheemadti lahem daniyyel chananya mishael vaazarya. "velo gealtim" — bime yevonim, sheheemadti lahem shimon hatztzaddik, vechashmonay uvanav, umattitya kohen gadol. "lechallotam" — bime haman, sheheemadti lahem mordochay veester. "lehafer beriti ittam" — bime romiyyim, sheheemadti lahem shel bet rabbi vechachme dorot. "ki ani Adonai elohehem" — leatid lavo, sheen kol umma velashon yechola lishlot bahem.
Rabbi levi amar mehacha: "veim lo torishu et yoshve haaretz".
Rabbi chiyyay amar mehacha: "vehaya kaasher dimmiti laasot lahem eese lachem".

"Achashverosh", amar rav: achiv shel rosh, uven gilo shel rosh. achiv shel rosh, achiv shel nevuchadnetztzar harasha shennikra "rosh", shenneemar: "ant hu resha di dahava". ben gilo shel rosh, hu harag — hu bikkesh laharog, hu hechriv — hu bikkesh lehacheriv, shenneemar: "uvemalchut achashverosh bitchillat malchuto katvu sitna al yoshve yehuda virushalam".

Ushemuel amar: shehushecharu penehem shel yisrael beyamav keshule kedera. verabbi yochanan amar: kol shezzochro omer "ach lerosho". verabbi chanina amar: shehakkol naasu rashin beyamav, shenneemar: "vayyasem hammelech achashverosh mas".

"Hu achashverosh" — hu berisho mittechillato vead sofo. "hu esav" — hu berisho mittechillato vead sofo. "hu datan vaaviram" — hen berishan mittechillatan vead sofan. "hu hammelech achaz" — hu berisho mittechillato vead sofo.

"Avram hu avraham" — hu betzidko mittechillato vead sofo. "hu aharon umoshe" — hen betzidkan mittechillatan vead sofan. "vedavid hu hakkatan" — hu bekatnuto mittechillato ad sofo, keshem shebbekatnuto hiktin atzmo etzel mi sheggadol mimmennu battora, kach bemalchuto hiktin atzmo etzel mi sheggadol mimmennu bechachma.

"Hammolech", amar rav: shemmalach meatzmo. amri la leshevach veamri la lignay. amri la leshevach — dela hava inish dachashiv lemalka kevoteh, veamri la lignay — dela hava chaze lemalchuta, umamona yattira hu dihav vekam.

"Mehoddu vead kush", rav ushemuel chad amar: hoddu besof haolam vechush besof haolam, vechad amar: hoddu vechush gabbe hadade havo kayymi; keshem shemmalach al hoddu vechush, kach malach missof haolam vead sofo.

Kayyotze baddavar atta omer: "ki hu rode bechol ever hannahar mittifsach vead azza", rav ushemuel chad amar: tifsach besof haolam veazza besof haolam, vechad amar: tifsach veazza bahade hadade havo kayymi; keshem shemmalach al tifsach veal azza, kach malach al kol haolam kullo.

"Sheva veesrim umea medina", amar rav chisda: battechilla malach al sheva, ulevassof malach al esrim, ulevassof malach al mea. ella meatta: "ushene chayye amram sheva usheloshim umeat shana", may darshat beh? shane hacha, dikra yattira hu: mikkede ketiv "mehoddu vead kush", "sheva veesrim umea medina" lema li? shema minna lidrasha.

Tanu rabbanan: shelosha malchu bakkippa, veellu hen: achav vaachashverosh unevuchadnetztzar. achav, dichtiv: "chay Adonai elohecha im yesh goy umamlacha asher lo shalach adoni sham levakkeshcha vegomer". vei la dahava malech alayyhu, hechi matze mashba lehu?
Nevuchadnetztzar, dichtiv: "vehaya haggoy vehammamlacha asher lo yitten et tzavvaro beol melech bavel". achashverosh, ha daamaran.
b: (Siman: 364"20) vetu lekka? veha ikka shelomo! la selik malchuteh.

Hanicha leman deamar melech vehedyot. ella leman deamar melech vehedyot umelech — may ikka lememar? shelomo milleta achariti hava beh — shemmalach al haelyonim veal hattachtonim, shenneemar: "vayyeshev shelomo al kisse Adonai".
Veha hava sancheriv, dichtiv: "mi bechol elohe haaratzot haelle asher hitztzilu et artzam miyyadi"! ha ikka yerushalayim dela kavsha!

Veha ikka daryavesh, dichtiv: "daryavesh malka ketav lechol ammayya umayya velishshanayya di dayyrin bechol ara shelamchon yisge"! ha ikka sheva dela melach alayyhu, dichtiv: "shefar kodam daryavesh vahakim al malchuta laachashdarpenayya mea veesrin"!
Veha ikka koresh, dichtiv: "ko amar koresh melech paras kol mamlechot haaretz natan li Adonai"! hatam ishtabboche hu deka mishtabbach benafsheh.

"Bayyamim hahem keshevet hammelech", uchetiv batreh: "bishnat shalosh lemolcho"! amar rava: may "keshevet", leachar shennityayshsheva dato. amar: belshatztzar chashshev utea, ana chashevna vela taena.

May hi — dichtiv: "ki lefi melot levavel shivim shana efkod etchem", uchetiv: "lemallovt lechorvot yerushalam shivim shana". chashshevv: arbein vachamesh dinvuchadnetztzar, veesrim utelat deevil merodach, vetarte dideh — ha shivim. appek mane deve makdesha veishtammash behu.
Unevuchadnetztzar, menalan dearbein vachamesh shenin melach? deamar mar: galu besheva, galu bishmone, galu bishmone esre, galu bitsha esre.

Galu besheva — lechibbush yehoyakim galut yehoyachin, shehi shemone linvuchadnetztzar. galu bishmone esre — lechibbush yehoyakim galut tzidkiyyahu shehi tesha esre linvuchadnetztzar, deamar mar: shana rishona kibbesh ninve, sheniyya kibbesh yehoyakim. uchetiv: "vayhi vishloshim vasheva shana legalut yehoyachin melech yehuda bishnem asar chodesh beesrim vachamishsha lachodesh nasa evil merodach melech bavel [bishnat malchuto] et rosh yehoyachin melech yehuda vayyotze oto mibbet hakkele".

Tamne utelatin usheva — hare arbein vachamesh dinvuchadnetztzar. veesrin utelat deevil merodach — gemara, vetarte dideh — ha shivin. amar: hasheta vadday tu la mipparki, appek mane deve makdesha veishtammash behu.

Hayeynu dekaamar leh daniel: "veal mare shemayya hitromamta ulemanayya di vayyteh hayetiv kodamach", uchetiv: "beh belelya ketil belshatztzar malka [kasdaa]". uchetiv: "vedaryavesh madaa kabbel malchuta kevar shenin shittin vetarten".

Amar: ihu mita tae, ana chashevna vela taena. mi ketiv "lemalchut bavel"? "levavel" ketiv, may "levavel"? legalut bavel, kamma betziran — tamne, chashshev veayyel chillufayyhu chada develshatztzar, vachamesh dedaryavesh vechoresh, vetarte dideh — ha shivin. kevan dechaze dimlo shivin vela ipperuk — amar: hasheta vadday tu la mipparki, appek mane deve makdesha veishtammash behu. ba satan verikked benehen veharag et vashti.
Veha shappir chashshev? ihu name mita tae, deibbei leh lemimne mechorvot yerushalayim.

Sof sof kamma betziran? chadesar. ihu kamma melach? arbesar, bearbesar dideh ibbei leh lemivne bet hammikdash, allema ketiv: "bedayin betelat avidat bet elaha di birushelem", amar rava: shanim mekuttaot havo.

a: Tanya name hachi: veod shana acheret levavel veamad daryavesh vehishlimah.
Amar rava: af daniel tea behay chushebana, dichtiv: "bishnat achat lemolcho ani daniyyel binoti bassefarim". middekaamar "binoti" — mikkelal dita.
Mikkol makom kashu kerae ahadade, ketiv: "melovt levavel", uchetiv: "lechorvot yerushalami"!
Amar rava: lifkida bealma. vehayeynu dichtiv: "ko amar koresh melech paras kol mamlechot haaretz natan li Adonai elohe hashshamayim vehu fakad alay livnot lo vayit birushalam".

Darash rav nachman bar rav chisda, may dichtiv: "ko amar Adonai limshicho lechoresh asher hechezakti vimino", vechi koresh mashiach haya? ella amar leh hakkadosh baruch hu lemashiach: kovel ani lecha al koresh. ani amarti: hu yivne beti vikabbetz galiyyotay, vehu amar: "mi vachem mikkol ammo veyaal".
"Chel paras umaday happartemim", uchetiv: "lemalche maday ufaras". amar rava: atnoye atno bahadade, i minnan malche — minnayychu ipparche vei minnayychu malche — minnan ipparche.
"Behareoto et osher kevod malchuto", amar rabbi yose bar chanina: melammed shellavash bigde chehunna. ketiv hacha: "yekar tiferet gedullato", uchetiv hatam: "lechavod uletiferet".

"Uvimlovt hayyamim haelle vegomer". rav ushemuel, chad amar: melech pikkeach haya, vechad amar: melech tippesh haya. man deamar melech pikkeach haya — shappir avad dekarev rachika beresha, divne mateh kol emat devae mefayyes lehu. uman deamar tippesh haya — deibbei leh lekarove bene mateh beresha, dei mardu beh hanach, hane havo kayymi bahadeh.

Shaalu talmidav et rabbi shimon ben yochay: mippene ma nitchayyeyvu sonehen shel yisrael shebbeoto haddor kelaya? amar lahem: imru attem. amru lo: mippene shennehenu misseudato shel oto rasha. im ken shebbeshushan yehargu, shebbechol haolam kullo al yehargu! amru lo: emor atta! amar lahem: mippene shehishtachavu latztzelem.
Amru lo: vechi masso panim yesh baddavar? amar lahem: hem lo asu ella lifnim — af hakkadosh baruch hu lo asa immahen ella lifnim. vehayeynu dichtiv: "ki lo inna millibbo".

"Bachatzar ginnat bitan hammelech". rav ushemuel, chad amar: harauy lechatzer — lechatzer, harauy lagginna — lagginna, harauy labbitan — labbitan. vechad amar: hoshivan bechatzer velo hechzikatan, bagginna velo hechzikatan, ad shehichnisan labbitan vehechzikatan. bematnita tana: hoshivan bechatzer ufatach lahem shene fetachim, echad lagginna veechad labbitan.
"Chur karpas utechelet". may chur? rav amar: chare chare, ushemuel amar: melat levana hitztzia lahem. "karpas", amar rabbi yose bar chanina: karim shel passim.

"Al gelile chesef veammude shesh mittot zahav vachesef", tanya, rabbi yehuda omer: harauy lechesef — lechesef, harauy lezahav — lezahav. amar lo rabbi nechemya: im ken, atta metil kina basseuda. ella: hem shel kesef, veraglehen shel zahav.
"Bahat vashesh". amar rabbi assi: avanim shemmitchottot al baalehen. vechen hu omer: "avne nezer mitnossot al admato".

"Vedar vesocharet", rav amar: dare dare. ushemuel amar: even tova yesh bichrakke hayyam vedara" shemah, hoshivah beemtza seuda umeira lahem katztzohorayim. deve rabbi yishmael tana: shekkara deror lechol baale sechora.

"Vehashekot bichle zahav vechelim mikkelim shonim". "meshunnim" mibbee leh! amar rava, yatzta bat kol veamra lahem: rishonim kalu mippene chelay, veattem shonim bahem! "veyen malchut rav", amar rav: melammed shekkol echad veechad hishkahu yayin sheggadol hemennu beshanim.

"Vehashshetiyya chaddat (en ones)", may "kaddat"? amar rabbi chanan mishshum rabbi meir: kedat shel tora, ma dat shel tora achila merubba mishshetiyya — af seuddato shel oto rasha achila merubba mishshetiyya.

"En ones", amar rabbi elazar: melammed shekkol echad veechad hishkahu miyyen medinato. "laasot kirtzon ish vaish", amar rava: laasot kirtzon mardochay vehaman. mardochay — dichtiv: "ish yehudi", haman — "ish tzar veoyev".
"Gam vashti hammalka asta mishte nashim bet hammalchut". "bet hannashim" mibbee leh! amar rava: shenehen lidvar avera nitkavvevnu, hayeynu deamri inashe: ihu bekare, veitteteh
b: Bevutzine.

"Bayyom hashshevii ketov lev hammelech bayyayin". attu ad hasheta la tav libbeh bechamra? amar rava: yom hashshevii shabbat haya. sheyyisrael ochlin veshotin — matchilin bedivre tora uvedivre tishbachot. aval ummot haolam sheochlin veshotin — en matchilin ella bedivre tiflut.

Vechen bisuddato shel oto rasha, hallalu omrim: madiyyot naot, vehallalu omrim: parsiyyot naot. amar lahem achashverosh: keli sheani mishtammesh bo, eno lo madiyyi velo parsi ella kasdiyyi, retzonchem lirotah? amru lo: in, uvilvad shettehe arumma.

Shebbammidda sheadam moded — bah moddin lo, melammed shehayta vashti harshaa mevia benot yisrael umafshitatan arummot veosa bahen melacha beshabbat. hayeynu dichtiv: "achar haddevarim haelle keshoch chamat hammelech achashverosh zachar et vashti veet asher asata veet asher nigzar aleha", keshem sheasata — kach nigzar aleha.

"Vattemaen hammalka vashti". mikkede peritzta havay, deamar mar: shenehen lidvar avera nitkavvevnu, may tama la atay? amar rabbi yose bar chanina: melammed shepparcha bah tzaraat. bematnita tana: [ba gavriel veasa lah zanav].

"Vayyiktzof hammelech meod". ammay delaka beh kulle hay? amar rava, shelacha leh: bar ahureyayreh deabba, abba lokovel alpa chamra shate vela rave, vehahu gavra ishtatti bechamreh, miyyad: "vachamato baara vo".

"Vayyomer hammelech lachachamim", man chachamim — rabbanan. "yode haittim" — sheyyodin leabber shanim velikboa chodashim. amar lehu: dayyeynuha li. amaru: hechi naaved? nema leh: kitla, limchar pasek leh chamreh uvae la minnan. nema leh: shivka — ka mezalzela bemalchuta, amru lo: miyyom shecharav bet hammikdash vegalinu meartzenu, nittela etza mimmennu veen anu yodin ladun dine nefashot. zil legabbe ammon umoav deyatvi beduchetayyhu kechamra deyatev al duredyeh.

Vetama amaru leh, dichtiv: "shaanan moav minneurav veshoket hu el shemarav velo hurak mikkeli el keli uvaggola lo halach al ken amad tamo bo verecho lo namar", miyyad: "vehakkarov elav karshena shetar admata tarshish".
Amar rabbi levi: kol pasuk ze al shum korbanot neemar.

"Karshena" — amru malache hashsharet lifne hakkadosh baruch hu: ribbono shel olam, kelum hikrivu lefanecha karim bene shana kederech shehikrivu yisrael lefanecha? "shetar" — kelum hikrivu lefanecha shete torin? "admata" — kelum banu lefanecha mizbeach adama? "tarshish" — kelum shimmeshu lefanecha bevigde chehunna dichtiv behu "tarshish veshoham veyashfe"? "meres" — kelum mersu bedam lefanecha? "marsena" — kelum mersu bimnachot lefanecha? "memuchan" — kelum hechinu shulchan lefanecha?
"Vayyomer memuchan". tana: memuchan ze haman, velamma nikra shemo memuchan? shemmuchan lefureanut. amar rav kahana: mikkan shehahedyot kofetz barosh.
"Lihyot kol ish sorer beveto". amar rava: ilmale iggerot harishonot lo nishtayyer missonehen shel yisrael sarid ufalit.
Amri: may hay deshaddayr lan "lihyot kol ish sorer beveto"? peshita, afillu karacha — beveteh pardashka leheve!
"Veyafked hammelech pekidim". amar rabbi, may dichtiv: "kol arum yaase vedaat uchesil yifros ivvelet" —

"Kol arum yaase vedaat" — ze david, dichtiv: "vayyomru lo avadav yevakshu ladoni hammelech naara vetula"; kol man dahava leh beratta — ayyayta nihaleh. "uchesil yifrosh ivvelet" — ze achashverosh, dichtiv: "veyafked hammelech pekidim"; kol man dahava leh beratta — aytmera minneh.
"Ish yehudi haya beshushan habbira vegomer ish yemini". may kaamar: i leyachoseh kaate — leyachaseh velezil ad binyamin! ella may shena hane?
Tana: kullan al shemo nikreu. "ben yair" — ben sheheir enehem shel yisrael bitfillato. "ben shimi" — ben sheshshama el tefillato. "ben kish" — shehikkish al shaare rachamim veniftechu lo.
Kare leh "yehudi" — alma mihuda kaate, vekare leh "yemini" — alma mibbinyamin kaate! amar rav nachman: mardochay muchetar benimuso haya.

Amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: aviv mibbinyamin, veimmo mihuda. verabbanan amri: mishpachot mitgarot zo bazo. mishpachat yehuda omeret: ana gerami demityelid mardochay, dela katleh david leshimi ben gera. umishpachat binyamin amra: minnay kaate.
Rava amar: keneset yisrael amra leiddach gisa: reu ma asa li yehudi uma shillem li yemini. ma asa li yehudi —
